jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer
jobs.description: **About Parisi Labs** Parisi Labs is building foundational world models for physical industry. We are developing models that learn how complex physical systems behave and reuse that understanding across forecasts, scenarios, and operational decisions. Energy is our first proving ground. We combine historical and live data with operational context, bringing together machine learning research, data infrastructure, and software engineering to turn advances in modeling into useful technology for energy operators. We are a small technical team working directly with the founders on our core models, systems, and products. **About the role** Your initial focus will be Ask The Grid, our live product for exploring the power grid, its markets, and its assets. You will take technical ownership of the application and make it faster, clearer, more reliable, and more useful. You will work across React and TypeScript, maps and time\-series interfaces, APIs, accounts, data\-intensive workflows, and AI\-assisted product experiences. Your scope includes the public product, enterprise\-facing capabilities, and the application work needed for customer deployments. You will work directly with users and customers to understand their workflows, partnering with the founders, applied\-AI engineer, and data engineer on technical scoping and delivery. Your primary ownership is the shared product and the application layer of customer deployments. You will collaborate with, rather than replace, the engineers and researchers responsible for the underlying data and models. **What you'll own** * The public product: maps, radar, assets, network views, and how they work together as one dependable application. * The path from visitor to operator: accounts and organizations, saving and claiming assets, portfolios, private\-data connections, permissions, alerts, and reports. * Product architecture, APIs, performance, observability, reliability, accessibility, and the systems that keep the application dependable. * The agent's interaction quality: how context is selected, how sources are shown, and how the product handles uncertainty, unsupported requests, and unreliable answers. * Customer\-facing workflows and application\-level integrations, working with the engineers who own the underlying data and model systems. * Direct user feedback and production debugging, turning repeated friction into clearer workflows and better software. * Decisions, with the founders and technical team, about what becomes reusable product, what remains customer\-specific, and what should not be built. **What we're looking for** * Experience owning complex, data\-rich applications from an ambiguous user need through implementation, deployment, and production operation. * Strong React and TypeScript skills, together with the backend and API experience needed to own an end\-to\-end product outcome. * Product judgment: the ability to translate complex user needs into understandable interfaces and dependable workflows. * Experience with production debugging, performance, reliability, accounts, and permissions. * The ability to work directly with customers, ask precise questions, and separate the underlying need from a requested implementation. * Clear collaboration across product, data, model, and agent boundaries without treating those boundaries as someone else's problem. Experience with maps, time\-series interfaces, or other complex, data\-rich products is particularly relevant. **First 90 days** * 30 days: Ship to production, understand the product architecture, and identify where real user sessions encounter friction or stall. * 60 days: Ship an end\-to\-end improvement that measurably improves exploration, account creation, or completion of an operator workflow. * 90 days: Own the product application and deliver a practical technical plan for the next reusable capability, informed by product usage and customer needs. **Why join** You will own a live product rather than a narrow feature area. Your work will determine how users encounter and apply our technology, from public exploration to deeper operational use, with direct influence on product architecture, interaction quality, and what we build next. **Location and compensation** Location: New York City or Boston/Cambridge. This is a hybrid role — we expect in\-person collaboration 2–3 days per week. Salary range: $180,000–$260,000 USD.

jobs.title: Senior Operations Site Leader
jobs.description: Description: JOB SUMMARY The Senior Operations Site Leader is responsible for the overall leadership, performance, compliance, and strategic execution of the manufacturing site. This role provides direction across all site operations, including Manufacturing, Engineering/Maintenance, Planning, Shipping, Warehousing, and EHS, to ensure safe, compliant, efficient, and high\-performing site operations. The Senior Operations Site Leader serves as the senior leader for the location and is accountable for achieving site goals related to safety, quality, service, cost, productivity, employee engagement, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement. This position partners closely with functional, corporate and commercial leaders to align site execution with business priorities, customer expectations, and long\-term operational strategy. Procurement and sourcing remain globally managed under the Global Supply Chain and Procurement Director. Strong leadership in a matrixed organization and across all levels of the business and all functions will be essential to drive the Treatt culture forward. DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES The duties and tasks of the Senior Operations Site Leader will involve the following: Site Leadership and Strategy * Lead the overall site strategy and execution plan to support business objectives, operational performance, customer requirements and growth priorities * Provide leadership and direction to site department heads, including Plant Management, Manufacturing, Quality/Regulatory, Engineering/Maintenance, Planning, Shipping and Warehousing, EHS and Continuous Improvement * Ensure strong alignment across functions so that site priorities are clear, resources are effectively deployed and decisions support safety, quality, service and cost objectives * Serve as the senior site representative and primary point of accountability for site performance, culture, communication and execution * Drive standardization of business processes across the site, aligned with the wider Döhler Group * Support the SAP roll\-out for the site, driving readiness and adoption across all site functions * Lead effectively within a matrixed organization to execute on milestones and move Treatt North America forward to increased success Operational Performance * Oversee site operations to ensure achievement of production, service, quality, safety, cost and productivity goals * Partner with the Plant Manager and operational leaders to identify performance gaps, resolve issues and implement sustainable improvements * Monitor key performance indicators and use data to drive decision\-making and accountability, taking counter actions to bring performance back on track * Ensure effective planning and execution of production schedules, capacity planning, labor utilization, material flow and operational readiness Engineering, Maintenance and Asset Reliability * Provide leadership and direction to Engineering and Maintenance, ensuring asset reliability, equipment uptime, preventive maintenance and technical support meet site performance requirements * Own the site capital plan end to end, from identifying and justifying investment through approval, execution and post\-implementation review, ensuring projects deliver the expected operational and financial return * Apply sound technical and engineering judgment to process improvement, debottlenecking, capacity expansion, automation and the introduction of new equipment or processes * Ensure engineering standards, process safety requirements and management of change are applied consistently to all site projects, modifications and new installations * Balance short\-term production demands against long\-term asset health, ensuring maintenance and reliability are not deferred in ways that create future risk Safety, Health and Environment * Drive a continuously improving, safety\-first culture so all our employees go home safely every day, with accountability for the HSE performance of the site * Hold leaders accountable for safe work practices, risk reduction, incident prevention and timely corrective action * Partner with EHS leadership to strengthen programs, improve safety performance and build employee ownership of safety expectations Quality, Regulatory and Compliance * Ensure the site operates in compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, customer standards, company policies, food safety requirements, quality systems and audit expectations * Support a strong quality and compliance culture, ensuring that production goals do not compromise product quality, regulatory obligations or customer trust * Partner with Quality and Regulatory leaders to maintain inspection readiness, address audit findings and drive corrective and preventive actions * Ensure work is performed in accordance with appropriate Standard Operating Procedures, policies and practices Planning and Warehousing * Lead site planning, shipping and warehousing to ensure effective scheduling, inventory manag ing, with a ‘fail fast, learn fast’ mentality * Partner with Human Resources on workforce planning, talent development, succession planning, employee relations, training and change management * Communicate clearly and consistently with employees at all levels to reinforce priorities, expectations, progress and business context * Act in the best interests of the Treatt Group at all times Success Measures * Safety performance and risk reduction * Quality and regulatory compliance * Delivery performance, including OTIF and schedule attainment * Cost, productivity and budget performance * Employee engagement and leadership capability * Continuous improvement results, audit performance and inspection readiness Requirements: EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Process or Industrial) or a related technical field required, reflecting the process manufacturing environment. MBA or advanced degree preferred * Minimum of 10 years of progressive operations management experience in flavors, food ingredients or closely related regulated manufacturing environments * Minimum of 5 years of people leadership experience, including leadership of managers or cross\-functional teams * Demonstrated experience leading site operations, plant performance, safety, quality, service, cost and continuous improvement initiatives * Experience managing budgets, capital projects, cost improvement initiatives and operational performance metrics * Technical or engineering grounding in a process manufacturing environment, with the ability to engage credibly with engineers and technical specialists on equipment, process design, reliability and capital investment decisions * Experience overseeing an engineering or maintenance function, including preventive maintenance programs, asset reliability and plant capital planning * Experience working in a global organization or matrixed reporting environment preferred * GMP, Six Sigma and 5S implementation expertise required; formal Lean or Six Sigma certification preferred * Advanced SAP or (ERP) user; experience contributing to or leading SAP or (ERP) rollouts strongly preferred SKILLS \& ABILITIES * Can do attitude, focused on delivery not title * Strong organizational skills, with the ability to plan and deliver multiple projects to clearly defined deadlines * Entrepreneurial vision – a self\-starter with a hands\-on approach * Ability to lead and influence a culturally diverse team * Strong operational focus and strategic vision to see the wider picture * Great interpersonal and relationship skills with the ability to lead, manage, motivate and influence teams and colleagues * Solid working knowledge of budgeting, operations, supply chain and strategic planning * Excellent understanding of financial data * Strong planning skills across production scheduling, capacity and materials management * Highly analytical, with strong communication skills to translate data into clear priorities and actions * Strong understanding of regulated manufacturing environments, quality systems, food safety and GMP requirements, EHS expectations and operational controls * Technical fluency in process manufacturing, with the ability to interpret process and reliability data, understand the unit operations and equipment that drive site performance and constructively challenge engineering and maintenance decisions * Strong problem\-solving and change management skills * Capable of difficult decision making – utilizing all the appropriate information required, and sharing views with key stakeholders WORKING CONDITIONS * Environment: Fully on\-site leadership role based at the Lakeland facility, with no home office arrangement. Office, lab and manufacturing environment, including shop floor exposure inside and outside production areas; potential exposure to hazardous chemicals * Physical Factors: Sitting, walking, standing * Travel: Occasional domestic travel with periodic overseas travel to the UK.

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
jobs.description: **About Dental Intelligence** We are the leading player in the SaaS analytics and workflow space for dental practices, launched in 2015 to help dentists manage and grow their practices. Our best\-in\-class tech makes it more fulfilling to be a dental professional and easier to be a patient. Nearly 9,000 dental practices utilize our platform to practice smarter, generating an average top\-line production increase of 50% in the first 12 months. Whether a practice wants a comprehensive 2\-year growth plan or simply a more effective Morning Huddle, we take the busy work out of growth. Our platform helps practices find patients, schedule them, follow up, collect payments, file their forms, design their treatment plans, and so much more. We seek an experienced Sr Site Reliability Engineer who can help our organization to mature and scale the infrastructure behind our multi\-cloud SaaS platform. If the profile below sounds like you \- let’s talk! **About The Role:** We're looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to help us mature and scale the infrastructure behind our multi\-cloud SaaS platform. Most of our footprint runs on Microsoft Azure, built from the ground up around cloud architecture principles: autoscaling App Service and Container Apps workloads, VM Scale Sets, and Kafka\-based event streaming form the backbone. We also have a smaller, well\-run presence on AWS, and a Windows\-based on\-premises component that sits at the core of our product and integrates with our cloud environment. This role is primarily focused on Azure, where the biggest opportunity for impact lives, and you'll work across the full multi\-cloud picture. We'd like to see the on\-prem and cloud sides operate as a more unified, well\-integrated system than they do today, and that integration work is part of what makes this role interesting. This is a high\-impact role for someone who thinks in terms of systems rather than tickets, and who treats infrastructure like software. You'll have significant ownership over how our cloud infrastructure is architected, provisioned, secured, and operated going forward. If you get energized by taking a fast\-growing environment and giving it real architectural rigor (consistent patterns, full infrastructure\-as\-code coverage, sane permission models, and cost discipline), this role was built for you. We're looking for someone who wants to build the operating model, establish the standards, and lead the transformation. You should bring genuine software engineering discipline to how that infrastructure work gets done: everything in git, everything reviewed, everything automated. No snowflakes, no manual changes made "just this once." **Location:** This is a fully remote role available to candidates located in U.S. states where Dental Intelligence currently has employees. **What You'll do:*** Own the reliability, scalability, and security posture of our Azure environment end\-to\-end * Lead the effort to bring our infrastructure fully under Terraform\-managed IaC, replacing manual and ad\-hoc provisioning with repeatable, version\-controlled deployments * Treat infrastructure code like production software: everything lives in git, changes go through pull requests and peer review, and modules are tested before they ship * Define and implement a coherent Azure architecture strategy, including resource organization, naming and tagging standards, subscription and management group hierarchy, and network topology * Redesign and enforce least\-privilege access and permission boundaries across Azure RBAC, Entra ID, and service principals * Identify and eliminate wasteful or redundant resource provisioning, and build cost visibility and accountability into how infrastructure is deployed * Build CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure changes so that plan/apply, validation, and policy checks are automated rather than run by hand * Build monitoring, alerting, and observability practices (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, App Insights, or equivalent) that give the team real signal * Manage and modernize the Windows\-based on\-prem component that sits at the core of our product, and work to integrate it more tightly with our Azure environment * Bring the same IaC and automation discipline to bear on our AWS footprint as needed, keeping it as clean and well\-run as it is today * Drive incident response, postmortems, and reliability engineering practices such as SLOs, error budgets, and capacity planning * Partner closely with engineering teams to bake reliability, security, and IaC discipline into the software delivery lifecycle * Mentor other engineers on cloud, IaC, and software engineering best practices, raising the bar across the team **What You Bring:*** 6\+ years in SRE, DevOps, or infrastructure engineering roles, with deep, hands\-on Azure experience * Strong, demonstrable Terraform expertise is required. You should be comfortable designing module structures, managing state, and using Terraform to manage complex, multi\-resource environments from scratch * A genuine cloud mentality: you default to automation, reproducibility, and IaC over manual changes, and you get uncomfortable when infrastructure can't be traced back to code * A real software engineering mindset applied to infrastructure: fluency with git workflows (branching, PRs, code review), a bias toward automating anything done more than once, and discomfort with manual, undocumented changes * Experience with Windows Server administration, IIS, Active Directory/Entra ID, and Windows\-based application stacks, which are critical for the on\-prem component at the core of our product * Solid understanding of Azure networking (VNets, peering, private endpoints, NSGs), identity (Entra ID, RBAC, service principals and managed identities), and cost management tooling * Working knowledge of AWS core services (IAM, VPC, EC2/ECS, etc.) sufficient to support and extend an already well\-architected environment * Experience integrating on\-premises infrastructure with cloud environments (VPN/ExpressRoute, hybrid identity, hybrid networking) * A track record of introducing structure and standards into environments that grew organically or quickly; you enjoy imposing order, not just maintaining it * Strong scripting ability (PowerShell and/or Bash/Python) * Excellent judgment around security and access control; you think in terms of least privilege by default * Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy and ownership, including making architectural calls and driving them through to adoption **Nice to Have:*** Familiarity with CI/CD tooling (Azure DevOps) for infrastructure pipelines * Prior experience leading a cloud environment from an ungoverned state to a well\-architected one * Relevant certifications (Azure Solutions Architect, Azure Administrator, HashiCorp Terraform Associate) **What You'll Love About Dental Intelligence:*** Flexible Paid Time Off \+ 10 company\-wide paid holidays * Competitive Medical, Dental \& vision offerings, with buy up plan options, AND we match your HSA contributions. * Fully Paid Parental Leave * 401K Retirement savings plan with company match up to 5\.5% of your earnings\+ unlimited access to personal financial advisors. * Learning \& Development Reimbursement program * Company paid Life, Disability \& AD\&D * Mental Health support programs, Cellphone \& Gym membership Discounts, Corporate Sundance Passes, and more! **Please Note:** All offers of employment are contingent upon successful completion of a background check, which may include verification of education, employment history, and other credentials. By applying, you confirm that all information you have provided is accurate and complete to the best of your knowledge, and you understand that misrepresentation may result in disqualification or termination.

jobs.title: Site Engineer - Field Deployment
jobs.description: **About American Turbines** The power grid was built for a world that no longer exists. Centralized generation, hundred\-mile transmission lines, decade\-long permitting cycles. Meanwhile, demand is exploding: AI data centers, industrial electrification, remote operations that need megawatts yesterday and can't wait for utilities to catch up. American Turbines is designing small modular gas turbines, purpose\-built for distributed power generation. Machines designed from a blank sheet to be manufactured at scale, clustered in arrays. Hundreds of units operating in parallel, dynamically matching load like a compute cluster matches demand. We are a seed\-stage company backed by the investors behind SpaceX, Boom Supersonic, and Hadrian. **About the Role** The Site Engineer for our installation program will own how our first microturbine installation fits together at a site level: where the turbines are located, whether we need concrete pads poured, where the transformers go, and how the turbines line up with the electrical and pipeline connections they need. You'll be based in San Francisco, but plan on stretches of weeks on\-site during installation, not just the occasional trip. You will work the full chain from site plan to working installation, translating between what the turbines need, what the site has, and what has to get built to connect the two. This is not a role where the plan gets handed to you finished. You will be defining that plan yourself and then making sure it holds up once equipment starts showing up on\-site. **What We're Looking For** Experience with systems integration on complex industrial or power generation equipment, whatever the domain. Site planning, balance\-of\-plant, or similar work where you had to coordinate mechanical, electrical, and civil scope at once and make it all fit together in the real world, not just on paper. You default to walking the site rather than only working from drawings. You're comfortable being the person who has to catch the conflict between two other people's plans before it becomes a problem in the field. **Compensation** $150,000 to $200,000 base. Generous stock package. Medical, vision, and dental care. 2% matching on 401(k).

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Entry Level (Summer 2027)
jobs.description: **Why Gravitate?** At Gravitate, we’re on a mission to reinvent how refiners and gas stations buy, sell, and transport fuel. We are proud to serve this massive industry that touches nearly everyone’s daily life. Our AI\-powered technology suite is already delivering huge value for some of the world’s largest fuel companies, and we’re just getting started. We’re growing fast, and we want ambitious engineers and problem\-solvers to join us for the next wave of innovation. At Gravitate, you’ll work with modern tech, learn from experienced mentors, and see your ideas make an impact right away. Our culture is built on high performance and high positivity. We believe winning is a team sport — we share knowledge freely, support each other, and celebrate every win together. We’re obsessed with finding better ways to solve tough problems, and we know the next big idea can come from anyone, including you. If you’re a self\-starter, a natural leader, and someone who truly cares about the work you do, you’ll fit right in at Gravitate. #### **About the Role:** We are seeking a motivated and detail\-oriented Software Engineer (Entry Level) to join our growing technology team. This is an exciting opportunity for someone early in their career who is passionate about building software solutions that solve real\-world problems. You’ll work closely with senior engineers and cross\-functional teams to design, develop, test, and maintain our suite of applications across a variety of platforms. #### **Responsibilities:** * Own well\-defined tasks within your team’s product area, working closely with senior engineers on larger projects. * Deliver reliably against sprint commitments; flag risks as soon as you see them. * Participate in the team’s on\-call rotation while building a working understanding of monitoring and observability. * Participate in code reviews, taking direct feedback and acting on it while contributing to team knowledge sharing. * Develop working knowledge of the fuel supply and logistics industry as it applies to your team’s product area. * Follow the team’s established design patterns and conventions, and be able to explain design decisions in review. * Write clean, tested code, taking ownership of the implementation, automated testing, and validation over the quality of your work. * Communicate early and often, focusing on learning and providing feedback to your team. #### **Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field—or equivalent practical experience. * Internship, co\-op or professional experience in a software development organization * Solid understanding of software development fundamentals, algorithms, and data structures. * Familiarity with web development technologies, APIs, databases, and version control systems like Git. * Proficiency in one or more programming languages; **preference given to candidates with experience in our stack (Python, .NET (C\#), Typescript, React)**. * Strong problem\-solving skills and a willingness to learn new tools and technologies. #### **Nice to Have (but not required):** * Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP). * Experience with CI/CD systems like Github Actions. * Familiarity with Agile development methodologies. #### **Why Join Us?** At Gravitate, people are not replaceable parts—they are the heart of our success. We believe in open communication, teamwork, and clapping for each other at every opportunity. Our culture emphasizes growth, collaboration, and creating lasting careers. Problem solvers, go\-getters, and charge\-takers — we (really) want to hear from you.

jobs.description: **Skills** Azure DataBricks ADF, DataBricks, Python, Pyspark, ETL, SQL, LLM, RAG, AI/ML. **Mandatory skills** * 10\+ years in data engineering, with recent hands\-on delivery ownership. * Strong Databricks and PySpark jobs, workflows, Delta Lake, performance tuning * Expert SQL including the ability to read unfamiliar, poorly documented SQL at volume and reason about what it does and what it costs * Demonstrable query cost and performance optimization experience, this is a core requirement on this engagement, not a bonus * Incremental / CDC ingestion pattern\*\* design and implementation \- Azure data services — ADLS / Blob Storage, and Databricks on Azure. * Unity Catalog or comparable data governance and cataloguing experience \- Data profiling and reconciliation testing proving two pipelines produce equivalent output * Comfort working with PHI\-scoped healthcare data and the access controls that implies \- * Ability to work independently against ambiguous inputs and drive clarification, in a small team on a hard deadline

Want to make an impact with us? ***We are unable to support remote international applicants or routinely sponsor work visas.*** The compensation range for this job is: * **POSITION SUMMARY** The Systems Engineer is responsible for the design, implementation, and maintenance of telecommunications infrastructure, including legacy TDM systems, modern VoIP/IP\-based networks, SS7 signaling, and E911 services. This role ensures reliable, secure, and high\-performance communication systems across the organization. The System Engineer will design, deploy, maintain and support telecom systems including TDM switches, (DMS 100, DMS 10, Redcom, Mitel), VoIP platforms (MetaSwitch), SS7 signaling systems for call routing, number portability, CLASS features, and implement and maintain E911 systems ensuring compliance with public safety regulations. Manage all system backups and restoration protocols. * Plan and support network and computing infrastructure. * Monitor system performance and implement performance tuning. * Manage user accounts, permissions, email, anti\-virus, anti\-spam. * Oversee software and network security. * Provide training instruction on platforms, equipment, and related applications. * Maintain network and call routing translations in TDM switches such as DMS\-100, DMS\-10, Redcom, and Mitel. * Maintain and support VoIP platforms, primarily MetaSwitch, to ensure reliable voice services. * Manage SS7 signaling systems for call routing, number portability, and CLASS feature delivery. * Implement and maintain E911 systems to ensure compliance with public safety. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Education Required** ---------------------- College diploma in the field of computer science, computer information systems, or computer engineering. Relevant experience could be substituted for the educational requirement on a year\-for\-year basis. **Experience Required** ----------------------- Up to 3 years of experience leading to the ability to work independently in the role. We hope you’ll join us as we change lives through technology.

jobs.description: Duties Description The New York State Office of Information Technology Services (ITS) provides operational support 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days of the year, supporting more than 4,900 applications for 53 New York State Agencies. Specific Duties include, but are not limited to: * Work closely with other teams to implement and support usage of MS Dynamics 365\. * Troubleshoot and modify heavily customized forms, views and scripts to work with multiple browser types and versions. * Develop and implement new functionality per business and technology requirements * Ensure that the current functionality provided in CHOICES runs successfully, including web services with other systems, canvas applications, file uploads, SSRS reports, and data extracts. * Monitor event viewers and IIS logs and other tools for errors, unusual entries, and possible performance issues and address problems. * Communicate extensively with end\-users to resolve production problems and business unit inquiries, including Level 2 and 3 Help Desk tickets. Candidates in a bachelor’s degree program with at least 15 semester credit hours in computer science or a related field can substitute for one year of general information technology experience. Bachelor’s degree in any field including or supplemented by fifteen (15\) semester credit hours in computer science or a related field substitutes for three years substitutes for three (3\) years of general information technology experience. Any bachelor’s degree substitutes for two years of general information technology experience. Master’s degree or higher in computer science or related field substitutes for one year of general information technology experience. \*\*Specialty includes experience within one or more of the following information technology disciplines: artificial intelligence, cloud solutions, human centered design, product management, quality assurance, rapid application development, robotic product management, geospatial information services. o Appointment to this position is not final until all agency approvals have been granted. Additional Comments ITS will not offer permanent employment to any candidate unless the candidate provides documentation that they are authorized to accept work in the United States on a permanent basis. It is the policy of ITS not to hire F1 or H1 visa holders for permanent employment or to sponsor non\-immigrant aliens for temporary work authorization visas or for permanent residence. Fingerprinting and a background check is required for employment with ITS. Some positions may require up to 25% travel and/or lifting up to 50 lbs. Some positions are pending Civil Service approval. jobs.title: Platform / DevSecOps Engineer - Secure AI Systems
jobs.description: **Job Description:** **Collaborate****with Innovative 3Mers Around the World** **Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World** Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers. **This position provides an opportunity to transition from other private, public, government or military experience to a 3M career.** **The Impact****You’ll****Make****in****this Role** As a Platform / DevSecOps Engineer \- Secure AI Systems, you will be the principal hands\-on owner of the secure platform foundation for a new\-to\-the\-world AI architecture. You will design, build, automate, operate, secure, and ensure recoverability of an evolving environment that spans isolated cloud networks, hybrid infrastructure, and a future fully air\-gapped on\-premises platform. Working in partnership with the program's senior technical team, you will establish the foundation early, shape architecture decisions, and remain directly accountable for how the platform performs in real environments. Architecting and implementing scalable runtime components for real\-time inference, near\-real\-time reasoning, large offline simulations, cloud services, on\-premises deployments, and embedded or edge environments. * Own the end\-to\-end operation of business\-critical collaboration and software\-development platforms, including the compute, storage, networking, database, and runner infrastructure supporting isolated and air\-gapped environments. * Establish, build, and operate the secure platform foundation, with accountability for availability, performance, capacity, cost, maintenance, and day\-to\-day reliability. * Design and enforce Zero Trust boundaries across public, quarantine, DMZ, cloud, on\-premises, developer, and internal application environments using segmentation, least\-privilege access, and controlled ingress and egress. * Administer GitHub Enterprise Server, including repositories, permissions, ephemeral Actions runners, audit logs, upgrades, backups, and disaster\-recovery configurations. * Integrate identity, privileged\-access, secrets, key, and certificate services using federation, SAML, OIDC, RBAC, conditional access, credential rotation, and lifecycle controls. * Design, develop and operate a controlled software\-supply\-chain pipeline that scans, validates, traces, and securely promotes trusted source code, packages, containers, firmware, and other artifacts into protected environments. * Engineer geographically redundant backup, replication, restore, and failover capabilities across cloud and on\-premises environments, with recovery proven through routine testing. * Automate, monitor, and continuously secure the platform using reusable Terraform modules, scripting, centralized observability, vulnerability remediation, threat modeling and hunting, security reviews, threat detection. * Lead major incident\-response activities, including investigation, containment, recovery, root\-cause analysis, and implementation of corrective actions. **Your Skills and Expertise** To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications: * Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science, computer engineering, cybersecurity, or information systems (completed and verified prior to start) OR * High School Diploma/GED (completed and verified prior to start) and seven (7\) years of experience building, operating, automating, securing, or recovering business\-critical technology platforms and infrastructure. AND * Seven (7\) years of professional experience in platform engineering, DevSecOps, site reliability engineering, cloud infrastructure, infrastructure security, or a related field. * Three (3\) years of hands on experience designing, deploying, and operating infrastructure using Terraform across public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) and private cloud/virtualization technologies (e.g., OpenStack, VMWare). * Three (3\) years of production experience administering GitHub Enterprise Server or a comparable self\-hosted software\-development platform, including identity, permissions, automation runners, audit logging, upgrades, backup, and recovery. Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include: * Three (3\) years of scripting and software\-development capability using scripting languages like Python, Bash, and/or PowerShell, with disciplined use of source control, code review, testing, release management, and documentation. * Hands\-on experience designing, deploying, and managing highly scalable Kubernetes environments. * Hands\-on experience building greenfield infrastructure platforms and operating critical systems in air\-g controls aligned with cybersecurity frameworks such as NIST CSF, FedRAMP, CMMC, DoD STIGs, or comparable security standards. * A hands\-on, low\-ego working style; strong security judgment; comfort operating under ambiguity; and discretion when handling highly confidential or access\-controlled intellectual property. * Experience working with Agile Scrum methodologies. **Location: Onsite in 3M Center Maplewood, MN** **Travel: May include up to 5% travel** **Relocation Benefits: May be offered** **Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).** **Supporting Your Well\-being** 3M offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, 3M regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope. **Chat with Max** For assistance with searching through our current job openings or for more information about all things 3M, visit Max, our virtual recruiting assistant on 3M.com/careers. Applicable to US Applicants Only:The expected compensation range for this position is $145,676 \- $178,049, which includes base pay plus variable incentive pay, if eligible. jobs.description: **Title:** Electrical Engineer II **Client:** Alabama Power **Location:** Birmingham, AL **Contract:** 3 Years **Work Arrangement:** Hybrid – In office at least 3 days per week / 12 days per month Job Summary We are seeking an **Electrical Engineer II** to support the **Schatz Grid Visualization and Analytics Center (SGVAC)** within Southern Company’s Research \& Development organization. This role will focus on the development, maintenance, and application of **power system digital twins** , grid modeling and simulation, advanced analytics, and emerging electric grid technologies. The engineer will support research projects involving transmission and distribution systems, real\-time simulation, hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, and grid modernization technologies. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with **PSS®E, PSCAD™, RTDS® and/or OPAL\-RT®, power system modeling, EMT studies, and digital twin development** . Key Responsibilities * Develop, maintain, and apply **power system digital twins** for grid planning, operations, training, technology evaluation, and decision support. * Build, validate, and enhance transmission and distribution system models. * Conduct: + Steady\-state studies + Dynamic simulations + Electromagnetic transient (EMT) studies + Real\-time simulations * Utilize **PSS®E, PSCAD™, RTDS®, and/or OPAL\-RT®** for modeling and simulation. * Develop and support **hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL)** testing environments. * Integrate operational, planning, asset, and measurement data into digital twin and analytical applications. * Evaluate emerging grid technologies and develop technical recommendations. * Support research projects, pilot deployments, and technology demonstrations. * Collaborate with utilities, universities, national laboratories, research organizations, and technology vendors. * Prepare technical reports, presentations, publications, and project documentation. * Present technical findings and recommendations to internal and external stakeholders. Required Qualifications * **Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited college or university required.** * Strong knowledge of **electric power system analysis, modeling, simulation, and operation** . * Demonstrated experience developing and applying power system digital twins. * Proficiency with **PSS®E and PSCAD™** . * Experience with **RTDS® and/or OPAL\-RT®** for real\-time simulation and hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing. * Experience conducting steady\-state, dynamic, EMT, and real\-time simulation studies. * Experience integrating operational, planning, asset, and measurement data into modeling and analytical environments. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Preferred Qualifications * Master’s concentration in **Power Systems, Electric Energy Systems, Controls, Computer Engineering, or related discipline** . * Experience with **PMUs, synchrophasors, SCADA, EMS, DERMS, or digital substations** . * Programming experience with **Python, MATLAB, C\#, Java, or similar languages** . * Familiarity with databases, data analytics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning. * Experience working with electric utilities, research organizations, universities, national laboratories, or technology vendors. * **Professional Engineer (PE) license or ability to obtain licensure** preferred. Key Skills **Power Systems \| Digital Twin \| PSS/E \| PSCAD \| RTDS \| OPAL\-RT \| EMT \| Power System Modeling \| Grid Simulation \| Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop \| Transmission \| Distribution \| SCADA \| EMS \| DERMS \| PMU \| Synchrophasors \| Python \| MATLAB \| Grid Modernization \| R\&D**

jobs.description: *7\-Eleven is an iconic family of brands with over 86,000 locations, surpassing every retailer in the world. We revolutionize convenience, restaurants and fuel through cutting edge innovation — working hard to be the customer's first choice. 7\-Eleven empowers our employees to "activate awesome" and make a meaningful impact in their stores and communities every day. If you're ready to grow, lead and make a difference, come join our team and help shape the future of convenience.* EMPLOYER: 7\-Eleven, Inc. JOB TITLE: Software Engineer II LOCATION: 3200 Hackberry Rd. Irving TX 75063 DUTIES: Execute full product lifecycle (inception through deprecation) to create reliable and flexible Android apps bound for the Google Play Store and retail customer's devices. Collaborate with product owners, scrum masters, UI/UX and business teams to define, design, estimate and ship new features with 7\-Eleven application. As a senior developer actively participate in technical discussions with android team and analyze technical challenges and provide solutions. Use best and standard android libraries to make the application behavior more reactive, maintain higher level of abstraction and solve difficult operations. Use architectural patterns like MVP or MVVM to develop the application. Use Jetpack Compose technology to build UI screens. Modularize, refactor and migrate Java code to kotlin to keep application updated with android standard to support kotlin language. Integrate security\-based features Two\-Factor authentication, Biometric authentication within the app to extra layer of security. Follow the Agile methodology and use JIRA software to refine the stories and plan the work in sprint. Drive best practices approach to the continuous improvement of 7\-Eleven application, processes, and tools. Maintain documentation for all new android features during 7\-Eleven application development. Continuously discover, evaluate, and implement updates from android updates and Kotlin language to maximize development efficiency. Use Mix panel and New Relic analytics tools to capture and analyze user interactions and interests to show users interest\-based deals and rewards. Perform code reviews with the team and follow best coding practices. Work in Test driven development and use Roboelectric, Mockito and Mockk test frameworks for writing unit test cases. Using Gitlab to perform continuous integration of the code and create Test, Stage and Production environment specific builds. REQUIREMENTS: Bachelor’s or foreign equivalent degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, and 5 years of progressive, post\-baccalaureate experience in the job offered as a Senior Android Developer, or Software Engineer, or in a related/similar position. Experience therein to include the following: * 5 years in developing Android applications, Mobile applications and using Java; * 4 years with Kotlin, and Test\-Driven Development including Roboelectric, Mockito, and Mockk; * 3 years with Restful API integration using Retrofit, and Material Design for Android; and * 2 years with Jetpack Compose, CI/CD Integration, Gitlab, GitHub, and Analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Newrelic, or Crashlytics. CONTACT: Refer to Job \# YK2151072\-W \#LI\-DNI \#IND\-DNI \#PDN\-DNI *If an hourly or salary range is included in this ad it represents the range 7\-Eleven in good faith believes is the range of compensation for this role at the time of this posting. No amount is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable under the terms and conditions of the applicable policies and plans. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Adobe is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join the Adobe Risk Platform (ARP) team. ARP is Adobe's centralized, adaptive system for detecting, preventing, and mitigating fraud and abuse across products and services — protecting surfaces like Commerce, Stock, and Firefly with real\-time risk decisions, without degrading the customer experience. In this position, you will help build and develop machine learning models to identify fraudulent activity, detect abusive account behavior, and protect the experience of hundreds of millions of users. You'll work across the model lifecycle from raw behavioral data and feature engineering, to model training, deployment, and monitoring alongside senior engineers on the team. Key Responsibilities Help build and train ML models covering various fraud and abuse areas. These include financial transaction fraud, device\-related deception, and account and identity abuse. The goal is a unified, continuously\-updated trust and risk score. Contribute to feature engineering across transaction, device, and behavioral event data. Build and maintain feature pipelines on Databricks and Spark, transforming raw transaction and device event data into high\-quality model inputs. Help translate prototypes into production ML systems, working with senior engineers on scalability, reliability, and observability. **Support MLOps practices:** experiment tracking, model versioning, CI/CD, and production monitoring. Collaborate cross\-functionally with data science, product, and platform teams to understand fraud and abuse patterns across Adobe's surfaces. Stay ahead of advances in ML/AI, particularly in fraud detection and behavioral modeling, and bring relevant ideas to the team. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or related field (or equivalent experience). 5\+ years of professional experience building and deploying ML solutions, or equivalent experience through internships, research, or personal projects. Solid programming skills in Python, with hands\-on experience in PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit\-learn, or similar frameworks. Working understanding of the ML lifecycle — from data collection through deployment and monitoring. Eagerness to learn model optimization, inference efficiency, and production system integration, with support from senior engineers on the team. Preferred Qualifications **Coursework, projects, or professional experience in any of:** payment fraud, device fingerprinting, account takeover detection, anomaly detection, or graph\-based modeling. Exposure to sequence modeling, transformer architectures, or graph neural networks. Familiarity with Databricks, Spark, or large\-scale transactional/event pipelines. jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- BioVectra, now part of Agilent’s Advanced Therapeutics Division (ATD), is a CDMO producing active pharmaceutical ingredients at clinical\-to\-commercial scale across microbial fermentation, small molecules, plasmid DNA, mRNA, LNP, and sterile fill, operating from Charlottetown, PEI and Windsor, Nova Scotia. This posting is for the BioVectra assignment within Agilent's Operational Excellence (OEx) function. Agilent’s Operational Excellence function builds and embeds the production system on the manufacturing floor. The function exists to convert operational performance into capacity the divisions can sell. The Operational Excellence Lead owns this build across the full value stream, from fermentation through downstream recovery and purification to release\-readiness and leads through depth of expertise with no direct reports. Success depends on influence through the ATD OEX governance model: site leadership owns operating results, while this role owns method, cadence, capability build, and countermeasure discipline. This role works alongside site leadership, not above it. What You Will Do: * Own the production system build across the full value stream at your assigned site or campaigns, from incoming materials through to release\-readiness. Begin each deployment with a structured rapid diagnostic that reads the current state of the production system, daily management, and culture through direct observation, operator interviews, and quantitative evidence, and translate the findings into a sequenced deployment roadmap agreed with site operations and quality leadership. * Build and sustain tiered daily management from Tier 1 through Tier 4, leader standard work, visual performance management, Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC) boards, and clear KPI ownership at the line, with structured escalation that surfaces and counters abnormality the shift it occurs in. * Own and run the kaizen funnel for your value stream: prioritize, charter, and lead kaizen events and workshops that close KPI gaps in titer and yield stability, fermentation reproducibility, downstream recovery and purification yield, right\-first\-time execution, changeover through SMED, and the manufacturing\-to\-quality handoff. * Translate site and business objectives into floor\-level priorities through strategy deployment with defined ownership, milestones, countermeasures, and benefits realization. * Connect operational performance to the outcomes the divisions care about: throughput and sellable capacity, on\-time\-in\-full against client commitments, release cycle time, right\-first\-time, and the inventory, working capital, and cost that follow. Build and maintain a transformation scorecard as the single source of truth for KPI performance, value capture, and countermeasure tracking. * Use MES, electronic batch records, shop\-floor data systems, and analytics where they exist to feed the daily management system and surface process abnormality in real time. Identify where digital and AI tools earn a place in daily work, treating them as enablers of the production system rather than a parallel initiative. * Lead and mentor structured problem\-solving (A3 and PSP) at the Gemba on the real constraints across the value stream, driving teams through root\-cause analysis rather than solving problems for them. * Lead value stream mapping across the batch lifecycle, including the transactional and quality flows where sellable capacity is most often lost, batch\-record review, deviation handling, and client response, then install the daily management and standard work that level the work and shorten time to release. * Partner with Quality to support the operating\-system elements of the release maturity roadmap, from conventional finished\-product testing toward parametric release and real\-time release testing where the process knowledge, client alignment, and regulatory pathway support it; the analytical science, filings, and release strategy belong to Quality, while the process understanding, standard work, and flow architecture belong to OEX. * Coach and develop supervisors, operators, and emerging practitioners in standard work, daily management, structured problem\-solving, and Lean fundamentals, and build the next generation of certified practitioners at all levels. * Be the method owner for the production\-system at your site. Embed standardized ways of working, governance routines, and accountability mechanisms that deliver durable results beyond individual kaizen events. Where leadership owns results and this role owns the method, cadence and countermeasure discipline that produce them. * Anchor to the Biovectra deployment through build and stabilization, embedding deep enough that daily management and standard work hold. As that system matures, contribute to benchmarking and best practice sharing across the North American ATD footprint so hard\-won lessons travel. **Qualifications** ------------- ee in a life science, chemical or biochemical engineering, or related field. * 8\+ years in a GMP or comparably regulated/complex production environment with direct, hands\-on accountability for process performance across the Make value stream, 10\+ years will be helpful. * Demonstrated, hands\-on experience deploying and sustaining a production or business operating system in a line role, whether the Toyota Production System, Lean, or the Danaher Business System (DBS), including strategy deployment, tiered daily management, kaizen, standard work, visual management, and structured problem\-solving. * A track record of delivering measurable, sustained business results through transformation, across safety, quality, delivery, throughput, yield, cycle time, cost, or client performance. * Deep command of structured problem\-solving and root\-cause methodology applied to real process problems, with the credibility to coach operators and influence senior leaders alike. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Platform and Cloud Services
jobs.description: As the most trusted global leader in data\-first contract lifecycle management (CLM) software, Agiloft helps organizations manage the end\-to\-end process of proposing, negotiating, signing, and leveraging contracts using our flexible Data\-first Agreement Platform (DAP). With contract data as the foundation, customers quickly and collaboratively reach agreement and leverage contract visibility to thrive with competitive advantage. Employing powerful, pragmatic artificial intelligence as a legal force multiplier, and robust integration capabilities as a data liberator, organizations around the world trust Agiloft’s certified implementers to deliver connected, intelligent, and autonomous solutions across the entire contract lifecycle. Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. Our no code platform is easily managed and administered by business users, which is why Agiloft is the contract you keep: nearly a full 100% of new customers are satisfied with their initial implementations, and some 97% of customers renew every year. Ours is a growing, vibrant, successful company that is at the forefront of a market that is becoming a must\-have for all organizations. We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that “EX \= CX”: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no\-questions\-asked wellness day.### **Position Overview** This is a foundational engineering role. You will own a critical domain of the platform on which Agiloft's CLM product is built as one of a small team of staff engineers who each own a core part of the platform and shape its direction together. This is a backend\- and distributed\-systems–weighted position with deep ownership of your domain and end\-to\-end accountability for its design, scalability, reliability, and security as the product and customer base grow. You will work across the organization with engineering leaders, senior engineers, product leaders, and partner teams to understand where the product is going, translate business and product goals into durable platform architectures, and align diverse stakeholders on the technical direction. This means, you will set architectural direction alongside a peer group of staff engineers of your caliber. This is a hands\-on leadership role that combines deep backend and cloud expertise with the influence to drive architecture across functional boundaries. ### **Job Responsibilities** **DATA MODEL \& PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE** * Own the canonical data models and service boundaries in your domain * Design models and boundaries that let independent systems evolve in parallel without duplicating logic or creating competing implementations * Evolve the platform through additive, backward\-compatible changes that introduce new capabilities without disrupting existing behavior. * Own the architecture of one or more critical platform domains, with responsibility for design integrity, scalability, reliability, security, and long\-term technical health. **DISTRIBUTED SYSTEMS \& CLOUD ARCHITECTURE (AWS)** * Design AWS\-native, event\-driven and asynchronous services that scale on demand, degrade gracefully under load, and remain cost\-efficient as volume grows. * Architect the backend to enable and support AI/ML workloads at scale with a focus on performance, scalability and cost efficiency. * Act as architectural steward for these services, keeping them scalable, resilient, secure, and maintainable as customer and platform demands grow. * Drive cloud\-native design principles: stateless services, managed\-service adoption, and failure\-tolerant, self\-healing architectures. **SECURITY \& MULTI\-TENANCY** * Treat tenant isolation, authentication, and authorization as first\-class design concerns across every service and API you own. * Design secure authentication and token\-handling flows, permission\-aware data access, and safe credential management for an enterprise, multi\-tenant platform. * Design for correct, isolated behavior across tenant, environment, and data\-residency boundaries, and reason explicitly about security posture and blast radius when centralizing sensitive capabilities. **TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP \& CROSS\-FUNCTIONAL INFLUENCE** * Partner with product\- and engineering leaders to develop a deep understanding of customer and business needs and translate them into platform architectures that solve the problem * Lead the technical design of major platform initiatives end to end, and drive alignment across teams and functions whose priorities and incentives do not always converge. * Integrate diverse stakeh of driving cross\-team technical direction to a decision. * Proven ability to drive technical outcomes across diverse stakeholders and teams that report into different functions, aligning divergent interests without direct authority. * Track record of owning significant initiatives end to end, including release ownership. * Strong proficiency in Python (working experience in Java a plus), building backend and jobs.description: **This is an onsite based position based out of our Lake Forest, California Office:** At Alcon, we're passionate about enhancing sight and helping people see brilliantly. With more than 25,000 associates, we innovate fearlessly, champion progress, and act swiftly to impact global eye health. We foster an inclusive culture, recognizing your contributions and offering opportunities to grow your career like never before. Together, we make a difference in the lives of our patients and customers. Are you ready to join us? This role is part of Alcon's Information Technology function, a team that delivers cutting\-edge technology solutions to Alcon associates and customers to help our people and the world see brilliantly. The Principal I, Embedded Software Engineer, is primarily responsible for leading the design and development of software solutions, leveraging advanced technical expertise to influence engineering teams and the broader organization In this role you will work on challenging embedded projects, applying your skills to design, develop, integrate and test computer\-controlled electromechanical devices in a Real\-Time Operating System (RTOS) environment. You will contribute to software risk management by writing software design and test documentation which thoroughly cover software requirements to ensure our products are safe for use on millions of patients and in compliance with regulations worldwide. As a member of our team, you will work with the latest technologies and software development principles, using your embedded microcontroller experience in C\+\+ and C programming languages. jobs.title: Senior Research Associate, Biosensor Assay Development
jobs.description: The Allegro team is united by a clear purpose—advancing technologies that make the world safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. With over 30 years of experience in semiconductor innovation, we bring that purpose to life across every part of the business—from breakthrough product development and customer success to how we show up for each other and the communities we serve. **The Opportunity** Allegro MicroSystems is building a pioneering team at the intersection of semiconductor technology and life sciences. We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Research Associate to become a foundational member of our new Manchester Molecular Sensors Laboratory. Working closely with the Principal Assay Scientist, you will play a key role in developing, validating, and scaling our Giant Magnetoresistance (GMR) biosensor platform. This position is ideal for a hands\-on scientist who enjoys laboratory experimentation, problem\-solving, and translating biological assays into robust sensor\-based diagnostic solutions. You will contribute to the development of multi\-modal assay workflows for protein, DNA, and RNA detection while helping establish the laboratory capabilities and processes needed to support future product development and customer applications. **What You Will Do** *Assay Development \& Optimization* * Execute and optimize biosensor assays across a variety of biological targets and sample matrices, including blood, serum, and saliva. * Support development of protein, nucleic acid, and multiplexed assay formats for GMR sensing applications. * Conduct experimental studies to improve assay performance, sensitivity, robustness, and reproducibility. *Surface Chemistry \& Process Development* * Perform surface functionalization, bioconjugation, and immobilization processes on sensor substrates. * Support the development, characterization, and optimization of surface chemistry workflows for biosensor manufacturing and scale\-up. * Contribute to process improvement initiatives aimed at increasing assay consistency and performance. *Data Analysis \& Technical Innovation* * Analyze experimental results using tools such as Excel, JMP, Python, or equivalent platforms. * Identify technical trends, troubleshoot assay challenges, and communicate findings clearly to project stakeholders. * Collaborate with scientists and engineers to develop innovative solutions for improving sensor performance and assay sensitivity. *Laboratory Operations* * Prepare reagents, buffers, controls, and test samples to support R\&D activities. * Maintain laboratory inventory, equipment calibration, documentation, and standard operating procedures. * Ensure laboratory activities comply with safety and quality requirements. *Customer Applications \& Product Support* * Assist in developing proof\-of\-concept demonstrations and customer\-specific validation studies. * Generate technical data and reports supporting customer evaluations, product verification, and manufacturing transfer activities. * Support high\-priority customer testing and application development efforts. *Cross\-Functional Collaboration* * Partner with electrical, mechanical, software, and manufacturing engineers to integrate biological assay requirements into system design. * Provide biological and assay\-development expertise during product development, verification, and troubleshooting activities. **What You Will Bring** * B.S. or M.S. in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Bioengineering, Chemistry, or a related discipline. * 3\-6 years of hands\-on laboratory experience in biotechnology, diagnostics, medical devices, or related R\&D environments. * Experience with standard laboratory techniques, including pipetting, solution preparation, dilution series, ELISA, or molecular biology workflows. * Experience with surface chemistry, bioconjugation, or immobilization of biological capture reagents. * Strong experimental design, troubleshooting, and data analysis skills. * Proficiency in Excel and statistical analysis tools; experience with JMP, Python, or equivalent software is highly desirable. * Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience working with biosensors, diagnostics, immunoassays, or molecular detection technologies. * Familiarity with process development, manufacturing transfer, or semi\-automated laboratory workflows. * Experience working in highly multidisciplinary product development environments. * Exposure to regulated product development or quality systems is a plus. **Why Allegro?** Join Allegro and become part of a team where your contributions truly matter. We foster a culture of **Real Innovation**, empowering you to push boundaries, develop cutting\-edge solutions, and drive continuous improvement. Your work will create a **Real Impact** by solving complex real\-world challenges that fuel our success and shape the future of technology. You’ll experience **Real Connection**, collaborating with talented colleagues around the globe in an environment built on trust, respect, and a shared purpose. **Join us—and help build what’s next.** *At Allegro, we are committed to providing a harassment\-free environment of mutual respect to fuel innovation through inclusive thought collaboration. Certain positions (such as field sales roles) may be exempt from this requirement.*

jobs.title: Security Engineer II, Amazon GuardDuty
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon GuardDuty is a customer facing threat detection service that was built to protect applications and services running in AWS. The service processes trillions of events and applies advanced analytics and machine learning to detect threats. If you are interested in learning about operating a service at massive scale and working alongside world class engineers, then this role is for you. The Security Engineer position will be working on Amazon GuardDuty, which is a managed threat detection service that continuously monitors for malicious or unauthorized behavior to help you protect your AWS accounts and workloads. It monitors for activity such as unusual API calls or potentially unauthorized deployments that indicate a possible account compromise. GuardDuty also detects potentially compromised instances or reconnaissance by attackers. This is an advanced engineering team that is using cutting edge techniques to help customers assess, monitor and protect their cloud based resources. We are looking for an experienced security engineer with red team penetration testing skills to join this team to research, tune and validate our detection mechanisms. A successful candidate for this role will have a deep understanding of both information security and computer science. If you can exploit at scale while remaining stealthy, identify and exploit misconfigurations in network resources, develop out of the box techniques, and communicate complex info in a digestible manner, you could be an ideal candidate. The scope of this role includes researching attack patterns, building attack simulations, active testing, and mentoring data scientists and software engineers. In this role, you will interface with many internal security teams to keep up to date with the latest attack techniques. Key job responsibilities As a Security Engineer, you’ll: * Recognize and safely utilize attacker tools, tactics and procedures * Develop scripts, tools or methodologies to enhance red team capabilities * Work with data scientists to help develop and test detections for complex exploitation patterns * Build simulations to validate tools and techniques * Advise broader team on current threat landscape, tools \& techniques * Ability to a detonate and analyze behavioral patterns of Malware * Create Intellectual Property, influence others while demonstrating significant creativity and being vocally self\-critical **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * 1\+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience * 1\+ years of designing and developing large\-scale, multi\-tiered, multi\-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C\#, C\+\+, Java, or Perl experience * 1\+ years of Object Oriented Design experience * Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field * Experience programming with at least one software programming language **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Your Amazon package will include sign\-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS is seeking a Senior Manager, Customer Success Specialists (CSS), Amazon Quick to lead a team of Service CSS driving enterprise adoption of Amazon Quick and AWS generative AI services. This is a people leadership role within the AWS Specialists \& Partners (ASP) Customer Success Center of Excellence, responsible for building, developing, and managing a team of customer\-facing specialists who help enterprises move from AI experimentation to systematic business process reinvention at scale with AWS AI services Amazon Quick is AWS's enterprise AI platform that enables organizations to transform how work gets done, from knowledge management and research to decision\-making and operational workflows. Your team will own end\-to\-end adoption outcomes for a portfolio of strategic Quick customers, progressing them through the post\-launch lifecycle and delivering measurable business value. You will set the operational cadence and quality bar for your team, ensure they have the skills, assets, and support to deliver customer outcomes, and partner closely with the rest of the Customer Success Center of Excellence team members (CS COE, who build scalable methodologies and assets) to create the flywheel between customer evidence and reusable patterns. You will also collaborate with the go\-to\-market, Forward Deployed Quick Engineers, partner\-led CS (PLCS), and field roles to ensure seamless handoffs and coverage across the activation backlog. Note: Demonstrable experience leading customer\-facing, AI\-centric teams is a key requirement for this role. Prior individual experience as an AI practitioner, while valuable, is not sufficient. This role requires proven ability to build, coach, and scale a team of specialists who drive AI adoption outcomes across enterprise customer portfolios. Key job responsibilities Team Leadership \& Development * Recruit, develop, and retain a team of Amazon Quick Service CSS who own end\-to\-end adoption outcomes within assigned accounts. Set clear performance expectations around activation targets, customer success plan quality, lifecycle progression, and contribution to scalable assets. * Coach CSS on executive engagement, change management execution, adoption architecture, and value storytelling. Ensure each CSS can run C\-suite alignment sessions, drive deep enablement, build champion networks, and deliver measurable business outcomes independently. * Lead the team operating cadence: weekly account reviews, monthly portfolio health checks, quarterly performance calibrations. Ensure operational excellence tooling entries are current, escalations are documented with impact data, and interventions are triggered within defined SLAs. Ensure weekly operational excellence tooling updates\[BS1\.1], lifecycle progression documentation, and telemetry monitoring. Hold CSS accountable for intervention triggers: root cause analysis of stalled adoption, product blocker escalation with documented customer impact. * Contribute to preparation for business reviews with account\-level data, portfolio health summaries, and recommended strategic actions. Represent the Quick Service CSS portfolio in bi\-weekly steering committee and monthly program reviews.
