jobs.title: Electric Engineering Analyst
jobs.description: ### **It's fun to work in a company where people truly** **BELIEVE** **in what they're doing!** *We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.* The Electric Engineering Analyst works under general supervision, performing a variety of moderately complex to complex electric engineering and geo\-spatial tasks in support of the Core Engineering and Operation Suite of applications such as the engineering analysis model, outage management software system, staking/design software system and the Electric GIS system.**Applicants must submit a cover letter and resume.** **Anticipated Start Date: On or after October 5, 2026\.** **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:** *Essential functions, as defined under the Americans with Disabilities Act, may include any of the following representative duties, knowledge, and skills. This is not a comprehensive listing of all functions and duties performed by incumbents of this class; employees may be assigned duties which are not listed below; reasonable accommodations will be made as required. The job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change at any time by the employer. Essential duties and responsibilities may include, but are not limited to, the following:* * Responsible for updating, maintaining and supporting the Core Engineering and Operation Suite of applications such as the Electric GIS, Engineering Analysis Model, staking/design systems and outage management system. * Responsible for maintaining the integrity, accuracy and availability of the core and enabling electric engineering technologies such as the engineering analysis model, staking/design system and electric GIS system. * Ensures the timely and accurate transfer of new and updated project information is from the Staking/design system into the Electric GIS database is accurate to meet the requirements of distribution system planning and maintenance and control center operations. * Ensures the asset and attribute data from completed new construction, line improvements, inspections, tree trimming, pole contact data and other projects. * Responsible for maintaining the equipment database in Electric Engineering Analysis software. * Responsible for the application administrator functions of the Core Engineering and Operation Suite of applications such as the electric GIS, Engineering Analysis, Outage Management System and the Staking/design software. * Works with the Electric Engineer and the Electric Design Supervisor in assisting the electrical design staff with electric distribution design needs. * Ensures that the integration/interfaces between Core Engineering and Operation Suite of applications and other applications are always up\-to\-date and functional. * Maintains the different GIS layers (including land base) to be consumed by the Core Engineering and Operation Suite of applications. * Assists and collaborates with the Electric Engineering Staff to conduct electric distribution system planning studies. * Develops a deep understanding of Georgetown Electric department’s operational technology solutions and maintains an understanding of changing technology and its impact on the electric utility. * Develops a deep understanding of Georgetown Electric department’s engineering standards, construction practices, and procedures. * Assists and collaborates with the engineering personnel in conducting special engineering operational and planning studies. * Assists in the development and maintenance of maps, map viewers, and other geo\-spatial tools with the use of ESRI's ArcGIS software, Milsoft’s WindMil Map, AutoCAD software, Partner Maps, or other electric utility project design technology. * Performs analysis of GIS data based on specified criteria and generates reports based on resulting data for use in projects and decision\-making processes. * Responsible for coordinating and interacting with other City of Georgetown departments and outside entities to ensure effective data exchange. Perform other duties and tasks as assigned. **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:** **Education, Training and Experience Guidelines:** * Bachelor’s degree in Geographic Information Systems, Spatial Science, Electric Engineering or related technical field and four (4\) or more years related experience using Geographic Information Systems and/or Electric Engineering Modeling Software; or an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential duties of the job. **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:** * Proficient in ESRI ArcGIS technologies such as ArcGIS Desktop, ArcSDE and utilizing ArcGIS Server technology, as well as associated applications. * Proficient in Milsoft WindMil \& Outage Management platforms. * Proficient in Design/Staking Software. * Strong knowledge of Electric Distribution engineering and operational technology domain. * Strong understanding of database concepts, querying, and reporting from SQL databases. * Skilled in use of office productivity tools (Example: Microsoft Office). **Preferred:** * Knowledge of electric distribution utility standards and practices. * Experience with electric system modeling and analysis software. * Strong communication skills and ability to work under pressure * Ability to provide innovative ideas for the ongoing development of work processes * Experience with AutoCAD software. * Knowledge of electrical transmission and distribution terminology and theory of operations. * Familiarity with surveying equipment and tools. * Willing to conduct job sites visits to support the upkeep of electric distribution model. **LICENSES AND CERTIFICATION REQUIREMENTS:** Valid Class "C" Texas driver’s license required. Out\-of\-state license holders must have a valid license and provide a three\-year driving history. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING ENVIRONMENT:** Standing, sitting, walking, lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling, reaching, handling, fine dexterity, crouching, bending, vision, hearing, talking, use of foot controls. **Hiring Range:** $44\.20 \- $55\.37, hourly. **\#LoveWhereYouWork!** Check out the benefits of working with us **here.** Regular\-Full time*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over\-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us**!*

We're looking for a hands\-on leader who sets the technical direction and builds alongside the team, with the curiosity to explore what AI can do for data and the judgment to know where it shouldn't. You’ll build the founding engineering team for CBI: hiring, coaching, and setting the operating model for how AI agents ship alongside them. This role is based in Southern California, with time across our Los Angeles and Irvine offices. **Key Responsibilities** * **Hands\-On AI\-Native Data Product Delivery (****4****0****%)** Your team ships the data and intelligence Capital Group runs on: everywhere it's consumed, by humans and AI. jobs.title: Director, AI Engineering (Remote - eligible)
jobs.description: Director, AI Engineering (Remote \- eligible) At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real\-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world\-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI \& ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world\-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high\-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build. **Team Description** The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand\-in\-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI, in responsible and scalable ways for the highest leverage impact. **About the Team** This team owns the infrastructure layer between applications and foundation models: model access, routing, reliability, security integration, observability, and cost management behind a single governed interface. Product teams build on the platform instead of integrating with model providers directly, which means the enterprise adopts new model capability once, centrally, rather than many times over. Sitting in the request path for every AI\-powered application makes latency, reliability, and efficiency company\-level outcomes rather than local ones. This team also owns a measurement and attribution layer that makes consumption legible to the optimization capabilities that act on it, including intelligent routing, caching, context optimization, and capacity planning. The objective is cost per unit of business outcome, not spend reduction in isolation. The architecture set now will determine the enterprise's cost curve and build velocity for years, and this role owns both those decisions and the teams that execute them. **In this role, you will:** * Partner with a cross\-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI\-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One * Oversee the design, development, testing, deployment, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc. * Make high judgment build\-vs\-buy decisions across a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, Nemo Guardrails, PyTorch, and more * Invent and introduce state\-of\-the\-art LLM optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems * Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One * Attract and retain top talent in the AI industry and nurture personal and professional development for your team. jobs.title: Senior Autonomy Validation Engineer
jobs.description: **Career Area:** Engineering**Job Description:** **Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.** When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. This **Senior Autonomy Validation Engineer** position will support Caterpillar’s Command for Hauling (CfH) Autonomous program with a strong focus on lab\-based system integration, validation, simulation, and machine performance analysis. The role will primarily support validation activities in L8 Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) environments, with collaboration across simulation systems, Test Track, Proving Grounds, and field\-support teams as needed. This position requires strong technical ownership, practical troubleshooting skills, and the ability to connect validation results with machine behavior and product performance. The engineer will work closely with SI\&V leads, development teams, product groups, test teams, proving grounds, and field\-support partners to improve release quality, reduce risk, and support customer\-ready CfH deployments. This role will also support development of simulation capabilities using real machine data, site data, logs, and test results to improve model fidelity, repeat field issues, and expand shift\-left validation coverage. **What You Will Do:** * Validate CfH autonomous workflows using L8 HIL benches, simulation environments, bench hardware, machine interface models, and supporting test assets. * Develop and maintain validation scenarios, test cases, regression tests, and evidence packages based on requirements, release content, field issues, machine data, and customer\-use cases. * Analyze real machine data, site data, logs, communication captures, and test results to understand machine behavior, identify performance gaps, and support root\-cause investigation. * Use machine performance analysis to improve validation coverage, confirm expected system behavior, and provide feedback to development and product teams. * Support development of simulation capabilities by using real machine data to improve model fidelity, reproduce field conditions, simulate operational scenarios, and strengthen CfH shift\-left validation. * Develop and maintain MATLAB/Simulink real\-time models for machine dynamics, actuator behavior, ECM I/O, signal simulation, and closed\-loop validation. * Configure, operate, and troubleshoot dSPACE SCALEXIO benches using ConfigurationDesk and ControlDesk, including deployment, parameter management, automated test execution, and bench bring\-up. * Integrate and validate communications across CAN/J1939, Ethernet/TCP\-IP, machine networks, and offboard connectivity, including timing, message integrity, and interoperability. * Integrate and validate sensor and positioning simulation for autonomous machines, including LiDAR, radar, camera, GPS, and IMU signals, with focus on interface accuracy, synchronization, calibration, and controllable fault modes. * Design, build, validate, and troubleshoot wiring harnesses and electrical interfaces supporting HIL benches and machine interface systems. * Troubleshoot complex CfH system\-level issues involving autonomy software, bench configuration, machine interfaces, simulation fidelity, timing synchronization, network behavior, and end\-to\-end workflow execution. * Document defects with clear reproduction steps, supporting data, bench configuration details, risk context, and recommended next actions. * Maintain traceability between requirements, scenarios, test cases, results, defects, and validation evidence to support release readiness. * Communicate validation progress, open issues, risks, mitigation plans, and release recommendations in a clear and data\-driven manner. * Identify opportunities to improve validation methods, automation, regression efficiency, simulation reuse, bench capability, and evidence generation. **What skills will you have:** * **Industry Knowledge:** Knowledge of mining autonomy, Command for Hauling, autonomous haulage workflows, machine applications, customer site operations, and validation environments. * **Software Product Testing:** Knowledge of validation planning, requirements\-based testing, scenario\-based testing, regression testing, test automation, defect management, and release evidence using tools such as JIRA and Azure DevOps. * **Systems Integration:** Ability to integrate and troubleshoot onboard autonomy software, MineStar/Fleet systems, machine ECMs, sensors, positioning systems, communication networks, and HIL/simulation environments. * **Problem Solving:** Ability to identify, isolate, and resolve technical and process issues affecting valida configurations, and integrated autonomous machine behaviors. * **Technical Communication:** Ability to communicate technical issues, validation status, test results, risk areas, and release recommendations clearly to engineering and leadership stakeholders. **Consideration for Top Candidates:** * Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, or a related technical field; advanced degree preferred. * Significant experience in validation, systems integration, product development, product support, simulation, or technical troubleshooting for complex autonomous, off\-highway, construction, mining, robotics, or vehicle systems. * Experience validating autonomous systems, preferably including Command for Hauling, MineStar/Fleet, machine control systems, HIL/SIL environments, test track, proving grounds, or field validation. * Experience developing and executing validation plans, regression tests, requirements\-based test cases, scenario\-based test cases, release readiness criteria, and test evidence packages. * Experience analyzing machine performance data, logs, site data, communication captures, and field/test results to support troubleshooting and product improvement. * Machine Performance Analysis and experience supporting Simulation Development projects. * Experience using real machine data to improve simulation models, reproduce field conditions, validate system behavior, or support shift\-left validation. * Strong understanding of V\-model verification and validation, agile or iterative testing methods, requirements traceability, defect lifecycle management, and release readiness practices. * Experience with L8 HIL bench operation, model\-based simulation, MATLAB/Simulink, dSPACE SCALEXIO, ConfigurationDesk, ControlDesk, or similar real\-time validation platforms. * Experience with machine electrical systems, harness integration, ECM interfaces, CAN/J1939, Ethernet/TCP\-IP, sensor interfaces, positioning systems, signal simulation, and integrated bench troubleshooting. * Strong communication skills for technical status updates, validation reviews, defect triage, test plan discussions, and stakeholder alignment. * Knowledge of AI, autonomy, simulation, perception, positioning, sensor fusion, or advanced validation methods is preferred. **Additional Information:** * This position requires the candidate to work full\-time at the Mossville, IL office * Domestic relocation assistance is available for this position. * Visa sponsorship is NOT available with this position. * This position will require up to 10% travel * \#LI **Summary Pay Range:** $112,710\.00 \- $183,140\.00 Compensation and benefits offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, job level, market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, individual performance and experience. Please note that salary is only one component of total compensation at Caterpillar. **Benefits:** Subject to plan eligibility, terms, and guidelines. This is a summary list of benefits. * Medical, dental, and vision benefits\* * Paid time off plan (Vacation, Holidays, Volunteer, etc.)\* * 401(k) savings plans\* * Health Savings Account (HSA)\* * Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)\* * Health Lifestyle Programs\* * Employee Assistance Program\* * Voluntary Benefits and Employee Discounts\* * Career Development\* * Incentive bonus\* * Disability benefits * Life Insurance * Parental leave * Adoption benefits * Tuition Reimbursement * These benefits also apply to part\-time employees This position requires working onsite five days a week. Relocation is available for this position. Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.**Posting Dates:** September 11, 2026 \- September 27, 2026 Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen. skills assessment, including VLOOKUPs and pivot tables) * Programming experience in Go (Golang) or a similar language (e.g., Python, C) * JavaScript fundamentals and eagerness to learn Svelte for modern web development * Understanding of web development fundamentals (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) * Familiarity with Git/GitHub workflows * Demonstrated ability to deliver straightforward, maintainable certificate/document template filler **C) Something else that demonstrates competence with Go programming and/or Svelte frontend development.** Examples: * A simple API with a Svelte frontend * A This role spans all phases of hardware development, from architecture and design through bring\-up, validation, and qualification, combining deep technical expertise with leadership and cross\-functional coordination. **Primary Responsibilities:** * Participate and contribute to the system hardware design. * Contribute to hardware specification, design, development, and test. * Work under department strategy and direction. * Work closely with software, diagnostics, manufacturing, marketing, EDVT, and MDVT test teams throughout the development process. **Minimum Qualifications:** * BSEE or MSEE with 7\+ years of experience in hardware board design and development. * Prior experience of taking a design from concept to production. * Prior experience in designing with x86 and/or ARM processors. * Prior experience in designing with DDR4/DDR5 memory, PCIe, SATA, USB. * Experience in schematic capture tools like Cadence Allegro Design Entry HDL (Concept HDL). **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience in using circuit simulation tools like HyperLynx, SPICE is a plus. * Experience designing Xilinx or Intel/Altera FPGAs or CPLDs using Verilog. * Prior experience in high\-speed board design/signal integrity and power distribution is critical. * Prior experience in designing Ethernet (10/100/1000Mbps, 10GE, 25GE, 40GE, 100GE) and serial interfaces like I2C, SPI, UART, RS232, etc. Why Cisco? jobs.description: Position Information **Posting Number** 2026624 **Position Title** City Engineer **Position \#** 6013 **FLSA** Exempt **Classification Type** Supervisory/Management **Department** Engineering Services **Job Type** Full Time **Work Schedule** Monday\-Friday; 8am\-5pm **Hiring Pay Rate** $140,000\-$170,000/year (depending on qualifications) **Posting Opening Date** 09/11/2026 **Posting Closing Date** **Job Summary** Under broad supervision and direction from the Public Works Director, plans, organizes, oversees, coordinates, and reviews the work of professional, technical, and administrative staff performing difficult and complex support related to all programs and activities of the City of Bryan Engineering Services Division. **Essential Job Functions** * Manages and participates in the development and implementation of engineering and traffic services goals, objectives, policies, and priorities. * With assistance from subordinate supervisors, oversees the work of engineers performing design of infrastructure, engineering review, and project management of development projects. * Carries out management responsibilities in accordance with the City’s policies and applicable laws, including: making employment decisions regarding hiring/termination; assigning major projects and reviewing work to ensure quality and timely completion; assisting in staff development and training; approving time; evaluating performance and addressing performance concerns; meeting with employees and management staff to identify and resolve problems; and performing other personnel actions to ensure productivity and quality standards are maintained. * Directs, coordinates, and manages the planning, organization, coordination, control and completion of development proposals. * Reviews and approves construction plans for subdivision development. * Reviews, manages, and presents Five\-Year Capital Improvement Plan. * Supervises construction inspection of public infrastructure required for development. * Provides recommendations and assists in capital improvement planning for the City with respect to streets, storm water, water and sanitary sewer. * Sets engineering standards of design and construction for streets and storm sewer. * Provides interface and communication for the department with management, boards, City Council, and the general public. * Addresses concerns from the public with regard to streets, drainage, and floodplain. * Performs related duties as required. **Minimum Qualifications*** Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering plus at least eight (8\) years of professional engineering experience with public works, storm sewers, sanitary sewers, and water supply systems; OR a Master’s degree plus at least six (6\) years of experience as listed above; OR a Ph.D. plus at least four (4\) years of experience as listed above Previous leadership, supervisory, or management experience is required. * *Equivalent combinations of education, experience, certification, and training may be considered.* **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities****Knowledge of:*** Progressive supervisory and management principles, practices, and methods. * The principles and practices of professional civil engineering. * Construction practices of municipal engineering projects. * Land development and land surveying. * Financial management, budget preparation, expenditure control, and record keeping, with the ability to manage capital projects and deliver results within budget and by established deadlines. * Safety standards, procedures, and precautions utilized in emergency response activities. **Ability to:*** Plan, organize, direct, and coordinate the work of personnel; delegate authority and responsibility. * Interpret and apply broad standards and policies to divisional operations. * Analyze a variety of administrative problems and make sound policy and procedural recommendations. * Prepare and administer a complex budget. * Research, analyze, and evaluate new service delivery methods, procedures, and techniques. * Maintain the confidentiality of sensitive information, records, or issues. * Ensure compliance with City and department rules, regulations, policies, procedures, and laws. * Prepare clear, concise, and complete reports, correspondence, presentations, and other written materials. * Organize workload, establish priorities, and meet established deadlines. * Be constantly alert and aware of any potential workplace hazards and ensure workplace safety. * Speak before City Council, and public and professional groups, about the City’s infrastructure plans, objectives, policies \& programs. * Provide City staff and management with sound advice and information regarding incumbent’s area of responsibility. * Establish and maintain effective working relationships with staff, other City employees/departments, City officials, and the public. **Skills:** * Demonstrated leadership, supervisory, and change management skills. * Strong verbal and written communication skills. Must be a strong public speaker. * Strong customer service skills, including the ability to handle escalated customer inquiries. * Strong planning, organizational, problem\-solving, and time management skills. * Strong computer skills with the ability to learn job\-specific software programs and applications used by the City of Bryan and the department as needed. **Licenses, Certifications \& Special Requirements*** Must be registered as a licensed professional engineer in the State of Texas **or** have the ability to gain reciprocity within one (1\) year of hire. * Must be a certified Floodplain Manager (CFM) **or** have the ability to obtain certification within the time frame set by management. * Texas Class C driver’s license with a good driving record as measured by the City’s evaluation system. **Physical Demands**Physical demands include but are not limited to: sitting, talking, hearing, seeing, standing, walking, driving, bending, reaching, twisting, pushing, pulling, using hands and fingers to operate office equipment and machines, and occasionally lifting and/or moving objects up to and including 25 pounds. **Working Conditions** Work is performed primarily in an office setting or a well\-lighted and temperature\-controlled working environment. **Equipment**Work shall be performed with tools, appliances and equipment approved by those agencies and bodies that have control, authority, or approval of the design working ranges or limitations of those items; the employee has the responsibility to conform to those ranges and limitations. Equipment may include but is not limited to: telephone, computer, printer, copier, scanner, calculator, and vehicle. **Additional Notes/Instructions for Applicants**This job description is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required. jobs.title: Mechanical Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** This is a high\-impact role that helps define how CoLab delivers technical value to its most strategic customers. You'll act as a dedicated technical problem\-solver and trusted advisor, embedding with enterprise customers to optimize how they use CoLab—especially our AI tools. You'll help large mechanical engineering orgs rethink how they manage feedback, data, and decision\-making across design and PLM. That means getting deep into customer workflows, testing new ways of working, and building repeatable methods the rest of the team can scale. You'll work within our forward deployed team, alongside a technical program manager, software FDE, and customer\-facing teams to close technical gaps, shape product direction, and directly influence customer success. This role isn't about selling or pitching—it's about deeply understanding engineering problems and solving them alongside the customer. ### **Our Ideal Candidate** You're a mechanical engineer by trade but your superpower is applying that knowledge in creative, systems\-level ways. You're curious, technical, and comfortable working through ambiguity. You've likely been a design engineer or worked in a PLM\-heavy environment. Maybe you've dabbled in automation, scripting, or app development for internal tools. You don't need to be the loudest voice in the room—but you can run a sprint, lead a cross\-functional project, and talk shop with both customer engineers and internal developers. If the average person might find this job too undefined or complex, that probably excites you. ### **Job Responsibilities** * Embed with enterprise customers to optimize CoLab usage, with a focus on AI tools like AutoReview and Operator. * Investigate and solve complex engineering data and integration challenges across PLM, ERP, QMS, and traditional design feedback tools. * Partner with a cross functional team to test and implement new CoLab workflows inside customer environments * Collaborate with product teams to identify feature gaps, improve capabilities, and refine AutoReview * Build technical documentation, playbooks, and repeatable frameworks based on successful projects * Provide mechanical engineering expertise to validate AI\-generated results and ensure engineering rigor ### **Qualifications** **Must\-haves:** * Background in mechanical design engineering, ideally in a medium to large sized organization. * Strong understanding of PLM systems and enterprise engineering data architecture * Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects and cross\-functional collaborations * Experience working directly with customers or internal stakeholders to solve technical problems * Comfort working in fast\-changing, ambiguous environments * Strong written communication and documentation skills * Working knowledge of high level AI architecture, specifically LLMs. * Familiarity with APIs, data integrations, and enterprise architecture concepts **Nice\-to\-haves:** * Experience with internal tool development, scripting, or automation * Exposure to AI/ML tools applied to engineering workflows * Prior work in design consulting or product development at scale ### **Extra Details** * This is a full\-time, permanent position with a competitive compensation package that includes stock options * Unlimited paid vacation, extended health benefits, and RRSP/401k matching * Remote\-friendly within Eastern or Central time zones in Canada or the US. * This role will have a travel component to visit customers onsite. Customer visits are typically 1\-3 days total, one or two a month. ### **Equity Note** Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic and apply even if you don't meet every single qualification—your potential is what matters most to us.

jobs.title: AI/LLM Engineer — Healthcare Payment Integrity
jobs.description: PLEASE NOTE BEFORE APPLYING: CODOXO IS NOT ABLE TO OFFER SPONSORSHIP OR ACCOMMODATE ANY CANDIDATES THAT ARE CURRENTLY BEING SPONSORED NOW OR IN THE FUTURE The United States spends roughly $4\.9 trillion on healthcare each year, and an estimated quarter of that is lost to waste, fraud, abuse, and error. Codoxo is the premier provider of AI\-driven solutions that help healthcare companies and government agencies proactively detect and reduce those losses and ensure payment integrity. We are purpose\-driven, with the goal of making healthcare more affordable and accessible to all. If you are passionate about applied AI and driven by positive impact in healthcare, Codoxo is where you belong. We are venture backed by some of the top investors in the country, with strong financials, and remain one of the fastest growing healthcare AI companies in the industry. Position Summary As an AI/LLM Engineer, you will design, ship, and operate LLM\-powered features that accelerate claim audits and SIU investigations — retrieval and question answering over case documents, structured extraction from claims and medical records, and investigator\-facing summarization. Just as importantly, you will build the evaluation systems that tell us whether any of it actually works. Our production stack is Python and Django on AWS, with Amazon Bedrock for inference, OpenSearch for vector and hybrid search, and Celery for asynchronous document processing. You will work on a small team where you own features end to end and your work reaches fraud investigators at national health plans and government agencies. As our LLM foundation matures, this role grows into multi\-step, tool\-using systems — MCP tools, Bedrock AgentCore, and multi\-agent orchestration. You would help decide *when* that complexity is earned rather than inheriting the decision. We are looking for someone who reaches for the simplest thing that clears the bar and can explain why. Key Responsibilities * Build and ship LLM features against real investigator workflows: document question answering, structured extraction, and summarization over claims, medical records, notes, and correspondence. * Own our retrieval pipeline end to end — document ingestion and extraction quality, chunking, metadata filtering, hybrid lexical and semantic search, reranking, and citations traced back to source text. * Build and maintain the evaluation systems that gate our releases: curated golden sets built with subject\-matter experts, regression suites that run on every prompt and model change, and rubric\-based grading validated against human reviewers. * Treat prompts as engineering artifacts — versioned, code\-reviewed, documented with change notes, and never shipped without an evaluation run. * Design reliable structured output: schema\-constrained generation, validation with bounded retries, and graceful handling of refusals, truncation, and partial results. * Build on serverless AWS — Bedrock, Lambda, S3, API Gateway, Step Functions — keeping PHI inside our trust boundary and out of logs and traces. * Keep cost and latency predictable as usage grows: token accounting, prompt caching, routing tasks to the right model tier, and asynchronous processing for non\-interactive work. * Instrument LLM features for observability and audit — prompt and model versions, token counts, validation and retry rates, retrieved document IDs. * Partner with investigators, clinical coders, and product to turn expert judgment into evaluation criteria, not just requirements. Qualifications * 3\+ years of professional Python experience. * 2\+ years building with LLMs in production — not prototypes or demos. You have shipped something real, watched it fail in ways you did not expect, and fixed it. * Hands\-on RAG experience: embeddings, vector or hybrid search (OpenSearch, pgvector, FAISS, or similar), chunking strategy, and the judgment to diagnose whether a bad answer came from retrieval or generation. * A real practice around evaluation. You can describe how you knew a feature was working, what your eval set looked like, and a time a metric misled you. * Working knowledge of AWS serverless — Lambda, S3, API Gateway — and at least one managed LLM service. Bedrock experience is a plus, but strong OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI experience transfers fine. * Comfort working with PHI or other regulated data, or genuine interest in learning to do it properly. If you meet most of this list, we would rather see your application than not. We are more interested in how you reason about LLM systems than in whether you have used our exact stack. Bonus Points * Healthcare domain data: FHIR, ICD\-10, CPT, HCPCS, and payer claims experience. Valuable, and something we can teach the right engineer. * Document extraction and OCR pipelines — the unglamorous work that determines whether everything downstream succeeds. * Amazon Bedrock AgentCore (Memory, Gateway, Runtime), Strands Agents, MCP servers, or A2A. * Event\-driven AWS: Step Functions, EventBridge, Glue/Athena. * Observability practice: CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, structured logging, incident response. * Parameter\-Efficient Fine\-Tuning (LoRA/QLoRA) and knowing when it is the wrong tool. * Agent frameworks: LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or equivalent. * Kubernetes/EKS, GPU inference, and caching strategy. * Explainability, bias monitoring, and responsible\-AI controls. Physical Requirements Work is performed in an office environment (either in our office or work\-from\-home) and requires the ability to work on a computer, operate standard office equipment, and work at a desk. Benefits for You * Competitive equity. * Health, dental, and vision insurance with 100% employee premium coverage (starts day 1\). * Unlimited PTO. * Annual professional development stipend. * Annual home office stipend. * 401K match (after 90 days). Accessibility Notice If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process due to a physical or mental disability, please send an email to careers@codoxo.com with the subject “Accommodation”. Reasonable accommodation requests will be considered on a case\-by\-case basis. We Are an Equal Opportunity Employer Codoxo prohibits discrimination of any type and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer II, GenAI Evaluation Framework
jobs.description: **About the AI Accelerator** The AI Accelerator drives AI innovation across Cox Automotive. The team builds proof\-of\-concept agents, ships reusable AI components, sets evaluation and governance standards, and partners with product teams to bring AI into production. **About the Role** Cox Automotive is hiring a Machine Learning Engineer II to own and build the GenAI Evaluation Framework (GEF), the shared capability that measures whether AI agents running in production meet quality standards. This is a builder\-owner role. You own GEF as an internal product, which means you set the roadmap, decide what ships and what gets retired, and sequence which teams onboard. You also write the evaluators, pipelines, and reference implementations yourself. The framework already exists and has been proved in one production implementation with the Virtual Contact Assistant. The current work is turning that implementation into a product other teams adopt on its merits, since adoption across business units is voluntary. You will have the direct support of the Director of Machine Learning and AI on prioritization and executive alignment, and full latitude on the technical and product decisions inside GEF. **What You Will Own** * **GEF product roadmap.** Shared accountability with AI leaders of what ships next, what to generalize from the first production implementation, and what to deprecate. You help to maintain the roadmap and the reasoning behind it. * **Enablement queue.** You sequence which product teams onboard, when, and against what success criteria, and you negotiate that sequence with the teams involved. * **Framework build.** You implement and maintain LLM\-as\-judge, rule\-based, and statistical evaluators, and calibrate them against human\-labeled baselines. * **Evaluation pipelines.** You build and operate the pipelines that score agent traffic on a schedule and publish results to dashboards and the Cox Agent Registry. * **Golden datasets.** You work with product teams and subject matter experts to assemble, version, and maintain the datasets evaluation depends on. * **Onboarding and adoption.** You integrate GEF into adopting teams' agents, debug failures, and write the documentation and reference implementations that let the next team self\-serve. * **Quality reporting.** You publish framework adoption, agent quality health, and cost\-per\-quality metrics each month, and supply the audit trails and evaluation evidence governance reviews require. * **Agent instrumentation.** You help add tracing and logging to agent workflows and integrate evaluation checks into CI and deployment pipelines. **What Success Looks Like in Year One** * Three to four product teams onboarded to GEF, with golden datasets curated and evaluators calibrated against human baselines. * A published GEF roadmap that adopting teams and leadership both plan against. * Framework capability a new team can adopt from documentation and reference implementations without direct support. * Quality health published per registered agent in the Cox Agent Registry, on a monthly cadence, without manual assembly. * Pipelines that run reliably, with monitoring and runbooks that let someone else operate them. **Who You Will Work With** Inside the AI Accelerator: the engineers building GEF, the team embedded with the Virtual Contact Assistant pilot, and the broader CADS data science group. jobs.description: * San Francisco, California, United States Location: San Francisco, CA or New York, NY Work Model: Hybrid Employment Type: Full\-Time Compensation: $250,000 to $300,000 base \+ equity **Overview** An early\-stage technology company is building machine learning systems for complex, high\-consequence government applications. jobs.description: **R\&D Software Engineer** **About PDCflow** PDCflow is a proven leader in payment management and digital workflow software. Collecting payments, securing e\-signatures, and delivering invoices are the lifelines of business operation, but managing them separately can be tedious and time\-consuming. Our comprehensive platform combines secure payments and document workflows into one frictionless experience, leveraging decades of compliance expertise to streamline operations for our customers. **Role Overview** We are looking for a Software Engineer (R\&D Focused) to play a key role in building PDCflow’s next\-generation payment and transaction platform. First and foremost, you will be a hands\-on backend software engineer helping design, write, and deliver core features for our newest product. Beyond day\-to\-day product development, you will bring an exploratory R\&D mindset to the team: researching emerging technologies, building rapid proofs\-of\-concept (POCs), and identifying better ways to modernize our stack. Your main day\-to\-day work will be backend\-heavy (Java, Spring, PostgreSQL, Docker), building secure, high\-throughput engines for our new product line. Side\-by\-side with feature delivery, you will explore new tools (such as Claude Code and AI\-assisted dev workflows) and test lightweight frameworks (like Svelte) to continually optimize how our engineering organization builds, containerizes, and deploys secure financial technology. **What You’ll Do** * **New Product Development:** Design, build, and deploy production\-ready RESTful APIs and backend microservices for PDCflow’s newest platform features using Java and Spring Boot. * **Database \& Data Architecture:** Write efficient SQL, design relational schemas, and optimize database performance in PostgreSQL to handle high\-volume transaction processing. * **Containerization \& Operations:** Package, run, and optimize containerized services using Docker across local and deployment environments. * **Targeted R\&D \& Prototyping:** Research, benchmark, and build targeted POCs for emerging tools and architectural patterns before bringing viable solutions into our core codebase. * **AI Tool Integration:** Experiment with and incorporate AI\-assisted developer workflows (**Claude Code**, LLM coding agents) to accelerate refactoring, testing, documentation, and feature delivery. **What We’re Looking For** **Core Technical Skills** * **5\+ years** of hands\-on software development experience with a strong foundation in backend engineering. * **Java \& Spring Framework:** Solid proficiency in Core Java and Spring Boot for building robust backend services and REST APIs. * **Database Fundamentals:** Strong SQL skills with **PostgreSQL**—ability to analyze, design, and optimize data models during POC development. * **Containerization:** Experience using **Docker** for local development setups, containerizing applications, and environment configuration. * **Exploratory Mindset:** A track record of testing new libraries, tools, and developer utilities on your own initiative. **Nice\-to\-Haves / Bonus Skills** * Active experience or curiosity in AI\-assisted development tools (**Claude Code**, GitHub Copilot, or CLI LLM integrations). * Familiarity with lightweight web frameworks like **Svelte** for rapid front\-end prototyping. * Exposure to fintech, payment processing, or compliance environments (PCI\-DSS, HIPAA). * Familiarity with microservices architecture, messaging queues, or cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP). **Why You’ll Love Working Here** * **Flexible Hybrid Model:** Enjoy the best of both worlds with a balanced hybrid schedule at our Ogden, UT office—alternating between 2 days in\-office one week and 1 day in\-office the next (just 6 days in\-office per month). * **High Autonomy \& Freedom:** You get dedicated time and space to investigate new tech without being locked into rigid, repetitive ticket\-slog sprints. * **Direct Team Impact:** Your research and POCs will directly influence the tech stack, tooling, and day\-to\-day productivity of the entire PDCflow engineering team. * **Modern Developer Culture:** We actively embrace cutting\-edge AI utilities like Claude Code to automate boilerplate work and focus on solving real engineering problems. * **Competitive Benefits:** Comprehensive Health, Vision, Dental, 401(k) match, generous PTO, and team perks.

You will find additional information about the job in the **Duty Statement**. ### **Position Details** **Job Code \#:** JC\-530106 **Position \#(s):** 843\-811\-3137\-XXX **Working Title:** **Engineer, WR** **Classification:** ENGINEER, WATER RESOURCES $6,488\.00 \- $7,735\.00 A $7,428\.00 \- $9,296\.00 B $8,896\.00 \- $11,131\.00 C $9,712\.00 \- $12,152\.00 D New to State candidates will be hired into the minimum salary of the classification or minimum of alternate range when applicable. **\# of Positions:** 1 **Work Location:** Butte County **Telework:** Hybrid **Job Type:** Permanent, Full Time ### **Department Information** **Division of Engineering, Construction Branch, Oroville Project Headquarters** **Oroville** Department of Water Resources (DWR) was established in 1956 by the California State Legislature. At DWR, we are embedding climate change response into every project we undertake. We have set standards to help evaluate how each project incorporates climate resilience principles and ensure consistency across the Department. jobs.title: BAS Technical Program Manager
jobs.description: DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission\-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high\-performance building systems. With over four decades of expertise, we partner with some of the world’s most influential companies to design and optimize environments that demand precision, scalability, and resilience. **Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.** **Position Title:** BAS Technical Program Manager **Position Location:** Remote \- work virtually from anywhere in the United States **SALARY** DLB recognizes salary ranges from job boards do not necessarily reflect our pay ranges. In many instances we out\-compete those ranges for well\-qualified candidates. **JOB SUMMARY** The BAS Technical Program Manager supports DLB’s mission critical projects, with a primary focus on building automation systems (BAS), PMS (Power Management System), controls integration, and smart building solutions. This role provides technical and project leadership for the planning, and design of BAS/PMS and integrated control systems and develops and maintains DLB controls standards. The BAS Technical Program Manager collaborates closely with out\-source partners, MEP design engineers, construction contractors, equipment vendors, software engineers, project managers, and client representatives to ensure systems are designed, integrated, and delivered in alignment with project requirements and client expectations. This position operates with a high degree of independence, receiving general directions on routine work and detailed guidance on new or complex assignments. The manager may serve as a technical lead / Point of Contact on projects of moderate to complex scope and coordinate the work of other engineering and production staff. The role communicates and operates in line with organizational goals, values, and departmental objectives. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS** **Engineering Design\-Support** **Activities** **(55%)** * Oversee subconsultant scopes of work, including the development, review, and coordination of Statements of Objectives (SOO), construction drawings, and technical specifications. * Ensure subconsultant deliverables are complete, accurate, and aligned with project requirements, organizational standards, and applicable codes and regulations using the DLB QAQC process. * Coordinate with project teams and external partners to monitor scope compliance, maintain quality expectations, and support timely delivery of design and documentation packages. * Create and manage project deliverables including design drawings, sequences of operations and specifications * Assist in development of various engineering drawings in AutoCAD and Revit format including floor plan drawings, system architecture diagrams, point\-to\-point wiring diagrams and control panel diagrams * Coordinate items with MEP trades that also affect BAS * Identify potential project scope changes and aid in development of strategies to minimize impact and control deviations from estimated costs and project deadlines * Management of project deliverables when they are not the lead design engineer **Standards Development and Maintenance (20%)** * Develop, document, and maintain BAS and EPMS production standards in conjunction with the BIM team. * Develop, document, and maintain BAS and EPMS specification sections. * Review existing standards regularly to ensure they align with customer needs, DLB graphics standards, and ongoing innovations in the industry. * Provide training, guidance, and support to staff regarding standards implementation and compliance. * Work closely with outsource partners standards and training staff to ensure compliance on all projects. **Assist** **in Construction** **Administration** **Activities (15%)** * Work as part of the engineering team and interact closely with the project management team * Manage and review shop drawings and submittals * Manage and review and respond to RFIs * Manage and review punch lists and project close out documents **Perform Onsite BAS Engineering Reviews (5%)** * Assist and manage onsite BAS engineering audits and feasibility studies * Assist and manage BAS engineering surveys for retrofit projects **Administrative (5%)** * Prepare and oversee development of project progress reports for internal and external stakeholders * Create / complete departmental reports * Accountable for project contract administration * **Technology, Digital Tools \& AI\-Enabled Efficiency** * Leverage AI\-enabled and digital tools to enhance efficiency, reduce manual effort, and support consistent, high\-quality work output. * Identify opportunities to improve processes and demonstrate a continuous learning mindset, seeking out new technologies, skills, and methods that elevate individual and team performance. * Adapt to emerging technologies and evolving digital workf  Ability to identify and analyze complex problems, evaluate alternatives and implement effective solutions * Ability to follow company and site safety requirements * Ability to analyze and prepare documents, reports and correspondence * Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form (technical and non\-technical information) * Ability to communicate effectively directly with clients and at times serve as primary point of client contact * Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with moderate supervision * Ability to effectively plan and delegate the work of others * Organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously **PHYSICAL DEMANDS** The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is * Frequently required to remain in a stationary position. * Frequently moving through office, facility, and other environments. * On occasion, may move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds. **TRAVEL / RELOCATION REQUIREMENTS** * Approximately 10% travel to client sites, partner offices, or company events across the U.S. * Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meeting for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc. **EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS** * B.A. / B.S. degree in Engineering, construction or related disciplines PLUS * Minimum of 8 years of experience in BAS controls systems engineering **Benefits** DLB Associates offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include * Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO\-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option) * Flex spending accounts (FSA) * Dental and vision plans * Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26 * 401k with company match and self\-directed brokerage account option * PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year * Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents * Short and long\-term disability, AD\&D coverage * Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement and professional licensing assistance * Paid parental leave after one year of employment CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is DLB's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non\-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location. DLB Associates is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and participates in the E\-Verify program with the Department of Homeland Security. We encourage diversity in our workforce. Are you ready to challenge yourself and redefine standards in the AEC industry? Apply now and join our award\-winning team! **NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES:** DLB does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to DLB in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where DLB has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of DLB and DLB will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service. **The pay range for this role is:** 126,788 \- 162,107\.05 USD per year(Remote (United States))

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- **At DPR, roles and responsibilities are more than describing a job title—they are a commitment to building great things together. The job description(s) below defines core responsibilities and the scope of the role and is a starting point. Every employee is expected to lead from where they are, take ownership of outcomes, and always act in the best interest of the team, customer, project and organization.** **As a purpose\-driven organization on a journey to be most admired, we rely on trust, shared leadership, open communication, disciplined action and a deep respect for the individual to drive exceptional performance. Success is not just about what we build, but who we build and how we build it: with integrity, enjoyment, uniqueness and an ever\-forward mindset.** **Job Summary:** Designs, develops, and maintains scalable full\-stack applications using modern front\-end and back\-end frameworks. Translates functional and technical requirements into secure, high\-performing software solutions aligned with cloud\-first and API\-first development principles. Contributes to continuous improvement of engineering standards, DevOps practices, and system reliability. **Key Responsibilities:** Designs and implements front\-end interfaces and back\-end services using modern frameworks and cloud\-native architecture patterns. Develops and maintains RESTful and GraphQL APIs aligned with enterprise integration and API lifecycle standards. Writes optimized database queries and supports integration with enterprise data platforms to enable secure and efficient data access. Participates in peer code reviews, ensuring code quality, maintainability, and adherence to established engineering standards. Evaluates scope changes and provides level\-of\-effort estimates to support sprint planning and prioritization decisions. Supports CI/CD processes, automated testing frameworks, and secure deployment pipelines to maintain release stability. Collaborates with product managers and cross\-functional stakeholders to enhance usability, performance, and technical feasibility of solutions. **Education Qualifications:** Orchestrates AI agents across the development lifecycle—from feature implementation to unit testing and code review—by writing effective prompts, configuring agent workflows, and validating outputs to ensure production\-ready quality with minimal rework. **Work Experience:** 2–4 years of experience in full\-stack development, software engineering, or related field required. DPR Construction is a forward\-thinking, self\-performing general contractor specializing in technically complex and sustainable projects for the advanced technology, life sciences, healthcare, higher education and commercial markets. Founded in 1990, DPR is a great story of entrepreneurial success as a private, employee\-owned company that has grown into a multi\-billion\-dollar family of companies with offices around the world. Working at DPR, you'll have the chance to try new things, explore paths and shape your future. Here, we build opportunity together—by harnessing our talents, enabling curiosity and pursuing our collective ambition to make the best ideas happen. We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work by our talented teammates and leading news organizations like U.S. News and World Report, Forbes, Fast Company and Newsweek. Explore our open opportunities at www.dpr.com/careers .

jobs.title: Engineer - Staff (ENS Renewable Operations)
jobs.description: Location: Detroit, MI, US Company: DTE Electric Company Job ID: 17830 DTE is one of the nation’s largest diversified energy companies. Our electric and gas companies have fueled our customer’s homes and Michigan’s progress for more than a century. And as Michigan’s largest source of renewable energy, we’re creating a cleaner, healthier environment to power our future. We’re also serving communities beyond Michigan, where our affiliated businesses offer renewable energy, emission control technologies, and energy services to industries in 19 states. But we’re more than a leading energy company... and working at DTE is more than just a job. At DTE, we take great care of each other and our customers, and we use our energy to be a force for growth and prosperity in our communities. When you join us, you’ll be part of a team that welcomes, recognizes, and celebrates differences and values everyone’s health, safety, and wellbeing. Are you ready to make that kind of difference? Bring your energy to DTE. Together, we can achieve great things. **Testing Required:** Not Applicable **Hybrid Role:** This role is hybrid, with an established schedule of in\-person work required at an assigned work location. Any remote work is expected to be performed from an employee’s primary residence, unless allowed (or prohibited) through the Company’s remote work guidelines. **Emergency Response:** Yes – Must be available to perform a primary assignment in support of DTE’s emergency response to storms or other events that impact service to our customers. **Job Summary** --------------- Intermediate level engineer responsible for independently evaluating, selecting and applying standard engineering techniques, procedures and criteria. Uses judgement in applying or recommending adaptions and modifications. Typical assignments are in the areas of engineering or scientific design, problem solving, and technical support for the optimum operation and maintenance of company assets. Participates on teams of field employees, technicians, engineers and other personnel. **Key Accountabilities** ------------------------ * Performs engineering assignments, proposing solutions to engineering related problems. * Works with experienced professionals to recommend and implement timely solutions involving routine engineering, design, operation, maintenance of company assets and market optimization. * Collaborates with more experienced engineers to provide follow\-up and engineering assistance on defined problems within time and budget constraints. * Develops models and analyzes data in order to recommend solutions and/or improvements in processes and programs; develops and presents presentations to all levels of management and/or external parties. * May provide field engineering assistance or technical support. * Keeps up to date on current technology and market/technology trends. **Minimum Education \& Experience Requirements** ------------------------------------------------ * Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or Engineering Technology and a minimum of 2 years of job relevant experience **Other Qualifications** ------------------------ **Preferred** * Electrical or Computer Engineering degree * Engineer\-in\-Training (EIT) / Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) license * Experience with implementation of data analytics or historian tools * Experience working with functional block logic on RTAC or PLC platform * Modbus, DNP or other industrial communication protocol experience * Proficiency in Microsoft Office programs, primarily Excel and Word * Experience with platforms such as: SEL, Ignition, GE SCADA **Other Requirements** * Intermediate analytical and problem solving skills * Strong time management, prioritization, and organization skills * Proficient communication and interpersonal skills **Additional Information** -------------------------- Incumbents may engage in all or some combination of the activities and accountabilities, and utilize a variety of the competencies cited in this description depending upon the organization and role to which they are assigned. This description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by incumbents in this job. It is not intended as an all\-inclusive list of accountabilities or responsibilities, nor is it intended to limit the rights of supervisors or management representatives to assign, direct and control the work of employees under their supervision. **PRIVACY NOTICE TO CALIFORNIA JOB APPLICANTS** *At DTE Energy, we are committed to providing an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and a sense of belonging. We seek individuals with a heart for service, a passion to help our communities prosper, and ideas to help shape the future of energy. We are proud to be an equal opportunity, employer that considers all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, religion, disability, national origin, citizenship, height, weight, genetic information, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status or any other status protected by applicable federal and/or state laws.* **Nearest Major Market:** Detroit

jobs.title: 0000001424.SOFTWARE ENGINEER III.INFO TECH - APPLICATIONS
jobs.description: JOB DESCRIPTION Designs, builds, and maintains scalable, secure, and user\-centric software systems. Serves as a technical lead within Agile teams, contributes to architecture discussions, and mentors junior engineers. Modernizes legacy systems, integrates enterprise platforms, and delivers digital solutions that support County\-wide operations and public services. RESPONSIBILITIES Designs, implements, and maintains complex software features and integrations. Leads sprint\-level delivery planning, execution, and retrospectives. Ensures consistent implementation of secure, performance, and maintainable code. Supports continuous delivery through automated testing and CI/CD pipelines. Conducts advanced code reviews and guides teammates on best practices. Monitors and optimizes system performance, scalability, and reliability. Coordinates with QA to ensure robust test coverage and defect resolution. Resolves high\-priority bugs, production incidents, and system degradations. Participates in architectural planning and proposes scalable technical designs. Decomposes business requirements into technical specifications and implementation plans. Identifies cross\-team dependencies and leads coordination for shared components. Contributes to product roadmap discussions by estimating complexity and technical feasibility. Ensures alignment of new features with platform strategies, patterns, and standards. Anticipates technical debt and proactively plan for refactoring or modernization. Creates and maintains system diagrams, documentation, and release plans. Collaborates with UX, product, and operations to deliver comprehensive user\-centered solutions. Establishes and enforces software quality and coding standards within teams. Promotes and models test\-driven development, CI/CD practices, and code coverage goals. Tracks and resolves system\-level issues, performance bottlenecks, and integration gaps. Leads or contributes to internal technical audits, retrospectives, and improvement plans. Helps define success metrics for feature delivery, scalability, and maintainability. Ensures adherence to accessibility (WCAG), cybersecurity, and compliance guidelines. Supports documentation of workflows, APIs, and business logic. Champions a culture of engineering excellence, accountability, and innovation. Serves as a technical point of contact for product owners, analysts, and designers. Coordinates with infrastructure, DevOps, security, and database teams for integrated delivery. Mentors and supports junior and mid\-level engineers in solving technical challenges. Represents the engineering team in stakeholder demos, reviews, and planning sessions. Works with vendors and third\-party partners on system interfaces and service agreements. Supports end\-user training, rollout planning, and adoption monitoring for new products. Fosters collaboration between development and operations (DevOps mindset). Actively participates in Agile ceremonies and cross\-team planning activities. Leads internal workshops, brown bags, or learning sessions on emerging technologies. Contributes to open\-source, internal tools, or reusable frameworks that increase efficiency. Stays up to date with industry trends in cloud, DevOps, data architecture, and security. Builds a network across County technical teams to share knowledge and collaborate. Supports onboarding of new developers and contributes to training materials. Serves as a role model for excellence in public service technology delivery. Translates technical concepts for non\-technical stakeholders in a clear and accessible way. Supports estimation, planning, and delivery tracking for executive and stakeholder visibility. Coordinates release readiness activities with product and support teams. Provides input on policy or operational impacts of technical design decisions. Ensures stakeholder requirements are implemented in a way that balances user experience and technical feasibility. Participates in technology working groups or governance forums. Provides documentation, reports, or demos as needed for leadership, procurement, or compliance. Advocates for the needs of residents, internal users, and service providers in all solution design. Performs other duties as assigned. QUALIFICATIONS **Minimum Qualifications:** **Education, Experience and Training:** Education and experience equivalent to a Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or in a job\-related field of study. Five (5\) years of related work experience in professional software development. **Certifications (Preferred):** * Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate, AWS Developer Associate, or similar cloud certification. * DevOps Foundation Certification. **Special Requirements/Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:** Must possess a valid Texas Driver’s License and good driving record. Will be required to provide a copy of 10\-year driving history. Must maintain a good driving record and remain in compliance with Article II, Subdivision II of Chapter 90 of the Dallas County Code. “Individuals holding or considered for a position which has, or may have, access to criminal justice databases including the FBI Criminal Justice Information Systems, NCIC/TCIC and similar databases, must pass a national fingerprint\-based records check prior to placement in such position and may be denied placement in such positions and/or access to such systems. Incumbents must also maintain the ability to pass the records check while in the position or until such time that the Commissioners Court and the County Civil Service Commission deem this position no longer has this requirement.” * Strong system\-level thinking, debugging, and design skills. * Strong leadership, analytical, and problem\-solving abilities. * Ability to mentor, guide, and coach junior software engineers. * Excellent interpersonal, communication, and collaboration skills. * Ability to deliver high\-quality, maintainable, and user\-friendly solutions. * Skill in full\-stack development using modern frameworks (e.g., React, .NET, Node.js, Python). * Knowledge of containerization, monitoring, and platform integration. * Skill in programming languages such as Typescript, Java, Python, C\#, JavaScript, or equivalent. * Knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases. • Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). * Knowledge of Agile methodologies, DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and microservices architecture. * Skill in enterprise application development and system integration. * Skill in Agile methodologies and software development lifecycle (SDLC). * Knowledge of RESTful API development and integration, and database design. * Knowledge of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud\-native applications. * Excellent debugging and performance tuning skills. * Ability to design and implement enterprise\-wide solutions with scalability in mind. * Skill in automating deployment pipelines and infrastructure management. **Physical/Environmental Requirements:** Occasional travel to County sites and industry conferences. Ability to work in a fast\-paced, evolving technology environment.
