jobs.title: Head of Deployment (Customer Success)
jobs.description: **About Flow** -------------- Flow is the systems engineering platform for the world's best hardware teams. Companies like Rivian run their programs on Flow, keeping requirements, interfaces, tests, and design decisions connected in one live system instead of scattered across documents and legacy tools. We're growing fast, backed by Sequoia, and selling into an industry that is actively rethinking how engineering work gets done. **The role** ------------ Flow is a system of record, and a system of record only delivers value when an engineering org actually lives in it. A requirements platform that half the team uses isn't half as valuable, it's worse than nothing, because now there are two sources of truth. So our post\-sale work isn't check\-in calls and QBRs. It's deployment: migrating requirements out of legacy tools and spreadsheets, configuring Flow around how each customer's programs actually run, redesigning workflows, and driving the organizational change that gets hundreds of engineers to move their daily work into a new system. You'll inherit over a hundred customers across SMB, mid\-market, and enterprise, a small team of reps who manage the renewal book today, the post\-sale side of our forward\-deployed team, a support motion that needs to be scaled, and a team plan that goes to 10\+ people in 12 months. You'll start as a true player\-coach: carrying your own book of accounts, running their deployments end to end, and owning their renewals personally. The methodology should come from the work and first principles, not another playbook from a different company. As the team scales, you'll shift weight toward leading, but the expectation is that you never fully leave the field. **What you'll own in year one** ------------------------------- * Carry your own book of accounts: lead their deployments, drive their adoption, and personally own their renewals * Define the deployment methodology: what "deployed" means, the phased rollout playbook, adoption measurement, and health scoring built on real usage rather than logins * Design the coverage model: embedded deployments for enterprise, guided rollouts for mid\-market, scaled low\-touch for SMB * Own renewals end to end, leading the reps who run the book today and building the motion around them, with expansion signals passed to the AE team * Stand up support: tiering, response expectations, and a clean escalation path into engineering * Assess, develop, and grow the team you inherit, then hire and ramp to 10\+, and shape the split of the current forward\-deployed team with our incoming Head of Solutions Engineering Compensation Range: $195K \- $265K

jobs.title: Metallurgical Laboratory Technician 1
jobs.description: Looking for a motivated individual with general labor, production, mechanical, and/or laboratory experience to work as a Metallurgical Laboratory Technician 1\. This is an entry\-level junior production position requiring no prior metallurgy experience. What is required is the willingness to learn, work hard, and have a quality mindset. All training will be provided by a mentor/trainer and based on established standard operating procedures and ISO company practices. Greater responsibilities and career progression is up to the individual as competency and proficiency on tasks are evaluated and measured by both the supervisor and individual. Some basic responsibilities include, but not limited to: * Performs sample characterization and testing safely following basic procedures * Collects and prepares samples * Records sample and testing information for engineers and project managers * Performs basic equipment and instrumentation maintenance * Promotes a culture of personal and team safety, including others who may be affected by the company’s operational activities Create a better future You will be a part of the leading brand in the mining industry, and we want to be even better. We also know we can only drive success and excellence with competent, passionate, and thriving employees. Joining a team of more than 11,700 people working across 60\+ countries, you will be part of an agile network of talented and ambitious people. In fact, we count on you to engage, connect, and collaborate with colleagues working on mineral processing projects all over the world. Seize the opportunity to learn, create and develop your potential with us. Key Job responsibilities for a Metallurgical Laboratory Technician 1: * Participates in daily sample preparation and related workflows * Supports engineering/metallurgical staff by performing mineral processing unit operations (screening, crushing, gravity concentration, leaching, filtration, flotations, etc.) as determined by the project * Maintains lab equipment and supplies * Basic calculations, reagent preparation with bench and pilot testing and/or assisting * Work safely and maintain a clean work area in accordance with standard lab practice and procedures * Other job duties as assigned Other abilities required: * While performing the duties of the job the employee frequently is required to stand, walk, lift, climb stairs, talk, listen, and use hands. * The position will be regularly required to work in laboratory testing environment, at a factory testing environment, or in a customer environment at times and is required to follow all safety requirements including PPE and safety policies. Work may also be completed in changing weather conditions. * Must be able to be tested and cleared to wear a half\-mask face respirator. * Must be able to safely lift 50 pounds continuously. * Customer site access requirements such as passing medical / physical evaluations for high\-altitude work may apply Work Environment: * Lab: 90% to 95% * MTRC Office: 5% to 10% * Off Site: \< 10% * When performing testing, the work environment requires use of personal protective equipment (PPE) such as: hearing protection, steel toe footwear, gloves, safety helmet, safety glasses, and respirator * Will take part in yearly safety trainings including, but limited to, MSHA certification, hazardous communication and response, first aid, etc. * When working at customer sites, the position is expected to work in multi\-cultural work environments, where colleagues come from different ethnic and cultural backgrounds with different educational backgrounds and language skills. * Typically, this position is a flexible 40 hours a week, Monday through Friday, 5 am to 5 pm shift. However, there is occasionally a need to work over\-time and be available for extended, after\-hours, or weekend shifts as required. What you bring * High school diploma or GED * Must be self\-motivated with a can\-do attitude * Basic math and familiarity with MS Office products required * Attention to detail and accuracy are critical * Good verbal and written communication skills required * Ability to work effectively in a team\-based environment * Strong interest in training and learning new laboratory methods * Able to occasionally work swing or night shifts (\<10% of yearly total hours) * Basic knowledge of safety procedures including personal protection equipment (PPE) and standard lab safety procedures * Lab work related to the minerals industry is a bonus * Chemistry experience/background a plus, but not required **This is for local applicants only. No relocation expenses or work visas are provided. Must be authorized to work in the United States.** Geographical location: * Local \- Salt Lake City, Utah, USA and surrounding area What we offer FLSmidth is an equal opportunity employer. FLSmidth also provides the following: * Medical, Dental, Vision * Matching 401K contribution up to a percentage * Flexible work schedule * Up to $250 yearly coverage for safety footwear * PPE provided We offer all employees access to a dedicated recognition platform, empowering you to celebrate achievements, share appreciation and stay connected globally.

jobs.title: Audio-Visual Design Engineer
jobs.description: At FORTÉ, every role plays a part in reimagining how the modern workplace works. Whether you're on the front lines with customers or behind the scenes making things run, your work helps people connect, collaborate, and get things done. From classrooms to control centers, we design and deliver the systems that power smarter, more connected workplaces – and it all starts with the people who make them possible. FORTÉ (formerly AVI Systems) is a 100% employee\-owned company with 50\+ years of experience and a bold new identity. **What You Will be doing:** * Provide technical expertise to support the architecture, installation and planning of audio, video and control solutions * Completes documentation with a high degree of quality and follows Technical Services Standards. Services include CAD drawings (flows, plans, elevations, details), system descriptions, equipment research, selection, custom product design and system integration. * Research and analyze the capabilities of available hardware and software options * Design audiovisual systems of various hardware and software components that work together as one integrated system and that meet customer’s specific needs * Support projects and our team throughout the implementation process. **Requirements to Assure Success:** * 3\+ years of Design Engineering experience is preferred. * Prior experience in the service and installation of audio, video and presentation systems * Knowledgeable of control systems (Crestron, QSC, Extron, AMX) and DSP platforms (Biamp, QSC, Clearone, BSS) * Ability to prepare, understand, and interpret advanced single\-line diagrams, architectural, construction, and electrical drawings * Knowledge of project financial reports, and the ability to control costs in the design and management of projects is essential * Ability to read engineering schematics and communicate design intent * CTS and CTS\-D certifications are a plus, but not required with the right experience. Any other industry related certs or training are also a plus. (Ex: Crestron, Extron, Biamp, QSC, Shure etc.) Why Should You Apply? At FORTÉ, your work matters, and it’s easy to see the impact you make. That’s because we’re 100% employee\-owned, and everyone here has a stake in how we show up – for each other, our customers, and the future we’re building. You’ll join a team that values your strengths, supports your growth, and shares your commitment to doing work that moves people and organizations forward. With bold momentum and a clear mission, FORTÉ is a place where you can bring your best – and build what’s next. The benefits of ownership At FORTÉ, you're not just covered – you’re supported. Our employee\-owners have access to a comprehensive benefits package designed to protect your health, grow your wealth, and help you do your best work. **Here’s a look at what we offer:** * Healthcare, vision \& dental coverage to keep you and your family well * Health Savings Accounts (HSA) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) for more control over your healthcare dollars * Employer\-paid life and disability insurance for added peace of mind * 401(k) with company match to invest in your future * Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) so you benefit directly from our shared success * Tuition reimbursement and ongoing learning opportunities to support your growth * Employer\-paid employee assistance program to care for your physical, mental, and financial health * Paid time off that helps you truly disconnect FORTÉ is an equal opportunity employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: Front is the customer operations platform built for B2B complexity, keeping every team, tool, and customer conversation in sync so companies can scale without losing connection. Others handle simple interactions. Front handles the coordination and context behind complex B2B customer relationships. Over 9,000 companies, including Uber Freight, Navan, and Stripe, rely on Front because it's the only one that can run the operational layer that makes customer\-facing work actually succeed. Backed by Sequoia Capital and Salesforce Ventures, Front has raised $204M from leading venture capital firms and independent investors including top executives at Atlassian, Okta, Qualtrics, Zoom, and PagerDuty. Front has received numerous Great Place to Work accolades, including **Top Places to Work by USA Today 2025**, **Y Combinator's list of Top Companies in 2023**, **\#4 on Fortune’s Best Workplaces in the Bay Area** ,**Inc. Magazine's 2022 Best Workplaces list**, and **Forbes Best Startup Employers 2022 List**. Front is looking for a Senior Solutions Engineer to join our world\-class Solutions \& Forward Deployed Engineering organization. You’ll be a trusted technical advisor to our most strategic prospects and customers, helping them transform customer service through AI, automation, integrations, and modern workflows. You’ll partner closely with Account Executives throughout complex enterprise sales cycles, owning the technical strategy from discovery through solution design, demonstration, proof of concept, and technical validation. You’ll develop deep expertise in Front’s platform, AI capabilities, APIs, and integrations to design creative solutions that connect Front with customers’ technology ecosystems. As Front evolves its AI\-powered customer service capabilities, you’ll help customers identify where AI can deliver meaningful business value. You’ll lead hands\-on proofs of concept that demonstrate real\-world impact and help technical and business stakeholders evaluate AI capabilities, performance, and limitations. This is a highly cross\-functional, customer\-facing role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys solving difficult problems, and can move seamlessly between technical depth, business value, and executive\-level communication. **What will you be doing?** --------------------------- * Partner with Account Executives on strategic opportunities, owning the technical strategy required to navigate and close complex enterprise deals. * Lead technical discovery to understand customer objectives, architecture, workflows, integrations, security requirements, and technical constraints. * Translate complex requirements into thoughtful solutions using Front’s AI capabilities, APIs, integrations, automation, and broader platform. * Design and deliver tailored product demonstrations that connect Front’s capabilities to customer use cases and measurable business outcomes. * Position Front’s AI\-powered customer service capabilities with technical and executive audiences, clearly communicating value, considerations, and limitations. * Architect and lead hands\-on AI proofs of concept and technical evaluations, defining success criteria and validating performance, feasibility, and business impact. * Serve as the technical lead for pilots and evaluations, managing technical dependencies, troubleshooting challenges, and ensuring successful outcomes. * Develop deep expertise in Front’s APIs and extensibility platform to design creative integrations with customers’ existing systems and applications. * Build credibility with Engineering, IT, Security, Operations, and Architecture teams while effectively communicating technical concepts and business value to C\-level executives. * Partner with Product and Engineering to bring customer insights into product discussions and influence Front’s roadmap. * Identify reusable technical patterns, demonstrations, and best practices that improve the effectiveness of the broader Solutions and Sales organizations. * Act as a senior technical voice in the field, raising the technical bar and mentoring other team members when appropriate. **What skills \& experience do you need?** ------------------------------------------ * **7\+ years of experience** in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or a similar customer\-facing technical role, ideally within enterprise SaaS. * Proven success partnering with sales teams to navigate and win complex enterprise opportunities. * Strong experience designing and demonstrating solutions involving **AI, automation, and complex business workflows**, translating technology into clear customer and business value. * Hands\-on experience implementing or integrating **AI\-powered products**, including leading customer proofs of concept and evaluating AI quality, performance, and impact. * Strong understanding of modern AI concepts and the ability to clearly explain their capabilities, tradeoffs, and limitations to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Strong technical foundation in **APIs, webhooks, authentication, data flows, integrations, and modern SaaS architectures**. * Experience working with REST APIs and independently prototyping or troubleshooting integrations. Familiarity with JavaScript, Python, or similar languages is a strong plus. * Strong software design and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to turn ambiguous customer requirements into scalable technical solutions. * Excellent communication and presentation skills, including experience engaging senior technical stakeholders and C\-level executives. * Strong business acumen and the ability to connect technical capabilities to outcomes such as customer experience, operational efficiency, productivity, and ROI. * Experience with customer service, support, contact center, CRM, communications, or workflow automation platforms is highly preferred. * A curious, hands\-on mindset and enthusiasm for experimenting with AI and solving challenging customer problems. **Front operates on a hybrid model — we come together in the office each Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday to collaborate and stay connected.** **What we offer** * Competitive salary * Equity (we are post\-series D \& backed by some of the best VCs in the US) * Private health insurance, including plan options at no cost to employees * Paid parental leave * Flexible time off policy * Flexibility to work from home Monday and Friday, unless posted as a fully remote role * Mental health support with Workplace Options * Family planning support with Maven * $100 per month Lifestyle Stipend to spend on fitness, health and wellness, and other activities * Wellness Days \- Fronteers get an additional day off on months with no holidays * Winter Break \- Our offices are closed from Christmas to New Year's Day! *Front provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability. By applying, you acknowledge and agree that you have read and understand the* *California Recruiting Privacy Notice* *\&* *EU Privacy Notice* Compensation Range: $160K \- $230K

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Technical Documentation
jobs.description: **Who We Are** FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. We work with many of the world’s top multinational corporations, law firms, banks and private equity firms on their most important issues to deliver impact that makes a difference. From resolving disputes, navigating crises, managing risk and optimizing performance, our teams respond rapidly to dynamic and complex situations. At FTI Consulting, you’ll work side\-by side with leaders who have shaped history, helping solve the biggest challenges making headlines today. From day one, you’ll be an integral part of a focused team where you can make a real impact. You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you. Are you ready to make your impact? **About The Role** FTI is building a data and intelligence ecosystem that will become the connective layer across FTI Technology's entire product suite. Corporate clients in regulated industries will ask hard questions before they commit: how are the AI models documented, how is their data handled, and what is the chain of custody. This role exists to make those questions answerable, and to build the documentation program that enables the rest of the Technology segment to operate at that standard. This is not a generalist writing role. It is a quantitative role whose primary output is documentation. **What You’ll Do** You will own the documentation infrastructure for FTI Technology's data and intelligence platform. That means the data dictionary, architecture documentation, API specifications, and integration guides. It also means producing model documentation packages for the platform's AI and ML capabilities: training data provenance, assumption disclosures, validation methodology, version history, and performance monitoring The API specifications and data dictionary are not reference materials. They are the contracts that allow IQ.AI, FTI Connect, Reveal, and Relativity to integrate with the platform without repeated engineering calls. Without them, every integration becomes a coordination bottleneck. This person removes that constraint. You will work across engineering, data, security, and operations teams, and with adjacent product teams including IQ.AI, FTI Connect, and TechOps, to extract technical knowledge and convert it into usable artifacts. You will communicate equally well with engineers and senior leadership. As the program matures, you will establish the documentation standards, tooling, and processes that other FTI Technology teams adopt. This platform is the first; this role shapes what comes after. **How You’ll Grow** We are committed to investing and supporting you in your professional development and we have developed a range of programs focused on fostering leadership, growth and development opportunities. We aim to promote continuous learning and individual skills development through on\-the\-job learning, self\-guided professional development courses and certifications. You’ll be assigned a dedicated coach to mentor, guide and support you through regular coaching sessions and serve as an advocate for your professional growth. As you progress through your career at FTI Consulting, we offer tailored programs for critical professional milestones to ensure you are prepared and empowered to take on your next role. **What You Will Need to Succeed** Basic Qualifications * 10\+ years producing technical documentation for data platforms, AI systems, or quantitative models in a professional environment. * A quantitative background (statistics, mathematics, econometrics, or equivalent). * This role requires travel to clients and FTI offices * Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis; this position does not provide visa sponsorship Preferred Qualifications * Understanding how models work well enough to identify where assumptions introduce risk and document those risks precisely. * Strong technical writing is the core skill. You can produce a detailed model specification that is technically rigorous and readable by a non\-technical stakeholder. * Ability to write an API reference that a developer can actually use. * Ability to set a documentation bar and hold it. * Experience in financial services, legal technology, or any regulated industry. * Familiarity with model risk management standards is highly valued. ***FTI Consulting is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, protected veteran status, religion, physical or mental disability, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, or any other basis protected by law, ordinance, or regulation.*** **Compensation** Minimum Pay: $149,000 Maximum Pay: $228,500 ***Compensation Disclosure:*** *The compensation range reflects potential base salary for the role. Actual compensation is determined based on a wide array of relevant factors including market considerations, business needs, and an individual’s location, skills, level of experience, and qualifications.*

jobs.title: Assistant Professor, Mechanical Engineering
jobs.description: **Job Description:** The School of Engineering and Computing at Fairfield University invites applications for a tenure\-track faculty position at the assistant professor rank in the Michael Zabinski Department of Mechanical Engineering. The start date for this position is September 1st, 2027, pending budget approval. Candidates in all areas of Mechanical Engineering or closely related fields are encouraged to apply. Position Description: This position requires an ability to perform teaching, scholarship, and service responsibilities. The successful candidate will be required to: (1\) develop and teach undergraduate and graduate courses (lecture and laboratory) in mechanical engineering. (2\) supervise Master theses, undergraduate research, capstone projects, and senior design projects; (3\) pursue scholarly activities (including externally\-funded research and peer\-reviewed publications); (4\) engage in academic advising and mentoring; and (5\) assist in program assessment, execution of the department’s continuous improvement plan, and documentation in support of ABET accreditation. The position is an academic (9\-month), tenure\-track appointment, and the salaries are competitive and commensurate with qualifications and experience. The School of Engineering and Computing is organized into the Michael Zabinski Department of Mechanical Engineering, the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, and the Department of Electrical, Mechatronics, and Biomedical Engineering. The Mechanical Engineering program is ABET accredited and offers Bachelor of Science and Master of Science degrees. In addition, students have an option to obtain a Concentration in either Automation, Robotics, and Manufacturing or Aerospace Engineering. The department is equipped with state\-of\-the\-art laboratories such as Material Characterization Lab, Automation, Robotics and Manufacturing (A.R.M.) Lab, Mechanical Engineering Lab, and the High\-Speed Fluids Research Lab. It also houses the Brinkman Manufacturing Laboratory and the Innovation Annex in support of teaching and research and boasts the highest undergraduate enrollment within the School of Engineering. Required Qualifications: * A Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering or closely related discipline. * Effective verbal and written communication skills. * Ability to effectively teach both undergraduate and graduate courses, including hands\-on labs. * Demonstrated potential to engage in funded research in a relevant field, along with a demonstrable publication record. Preferred Qualifications: Candidates with expertise in experimental and applied areas of Mechanical Engineering are encouraged to apply. Computational expertise is considered a favorable additional qualification when complemented by hands\-on, applied research and teaching experience. Areas of interest may include, but are not limited to, solid mechanics/structures, thermal\-fluid sciences, energy, aerospace, and other emerging areas of Mechanical Engineering. Screening of applications will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. Full consideration will be given to candidates who apply by November 1st, 2026\. The preferred starting date is September 1st, 2027\. Please combine and upload the following materials in **a single PDF document**. A complete application will consist of: (1\) a cover letter addressing the qualifications (one\-page), (2\) a statement of teaching interests and research plan (two pages), (3\) a curriculum vitae, and (4\) the names and contact information of three professional references (references will not be contacted without prior knowledge and approval of candidates). Applicants are encouraged to submit a project portfolio (three to five pages with annotated photographs or a link to a website repository) that illustrates hands\-on, project\-based contributions. Only complete electronic applications will be considered. Inquiries about the position should be addressed to the Chair of the Search Committee, Dr. David Shekhtman (engineeringsearch@fairfield.edu). For more information on Fairfield University, please visit www.fairfield.edu. For more information on the School of Engineering and Computing, please visit www.fairfield.edu/sec. **Category:** Academic \- Faculty Tenure/Tenure Track Performs such other duties, responsibilities, and activities as required by supervisor and as departmental/University needs indicate. * Disclaimer The above information indicates the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain and should not be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, activities, and/or qualifications required or expected of employees assigned to this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change and new ones may be assigned at any time, with or without notice. *All offers of employment are contingent upon a satisfactory background check.* Fairfield University provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training. **Load a resume or CV first, then upload supporting documents including a cover letter at the bottom of the third page under the "My Experience" section where it says to upload a** ***Resume/CV*****. You will be able to upload up to 5 other documents in this section. You will be unable to edit your application, so please have all documents available before applying.**  **Faculty Positions****: If you need to upload more than 5 documents, please either combine them to upload or email the additional documents to the applicable contact in the job description.** ================================================================================================================================================================================================ **Staff positions****: If you need to upload more than 5 documents, please either combine them to upload or email them to hr@fairfield.edu** ============================================================================================================================================

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, Unified Experience
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting \& Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. **About the Role** Support Fanatics Collect's Unified Experience initiative, building seamless collector journeys across Fanatics Live, Marketplace, Instant Rips, Collections, Topps, and future experiences. Today a collector can win a card in a live show, rip a pack, buy on the marketplace, and store it all in a vault — but those moments still feel like separate products. Your job is to make them feel like one. That means building the shared surfaces, APIs, and front\-end systems that connect experiences that were each built independently, and doing it without slowing any of them down. This is a hands\-on senior role. You'll own meaningful slices of the unified experience end to end — schema to API to UI — and you'll do it alongside a Staff Backend Engineer, mobile engineers, product, and design. **Why Join Us** Fanatics Collect is growing fast, and the unification work is the highest\-leverage engineering investment we have: every new app, drop, and live format gets easier once the shared foundation exists. You'll work across mobile, web, and internal tools, with real autonomy and a short path from idea to production. Your teammates are passionate about the space and most of them are collectors themselves. **Product Context and Scale** Our surfaces reach millions of collectors across iOS, Android, and web, with live, high\-traffic moments (breaks, drops, auctions closing) that make performance and reliability non\-negotiable. You'll be working in a landscape of multiple existing products with real users and real data, so migration, backward compatibility, and careful rollout are part of the craft. **First 90 Days** * Ship a meaningful, user\-facing piece of the unified experience end to end. * Build a working map of how Live, Marketplace, Instant Rips, Collections, and Topps actually fit together today — data models, identity, entitlements, and the seams between them. * Establish working relationships with the backend, mobile, product, and design partners you'll depend on. * Identify one piece of duplicated or divergent logic across surfaces and make the case for consolidating it. **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and maintain fullstack features using Python, FastAPI, Next.js, React, and TypeScript. * Build scalable, performant, highly available services and interfaces on AWS and Vercel. * Own features end to end: data model, API contract, front\-end implementation, tests, rollout, and post\-launch metrics. * Build and maintain reusable front\-end components, APIs, and shared libraries that multiple apps (web and mobile) depend on — and treat other engineers as first\-class consumers of what you Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we're building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Data
jobs.description: **Staff Engineer, Data** At Flagship Financial Group, we strive to make a positive impact on our customers’ lives through responsible auto financing and on our employees’ careers through continuous learning and advancement opportunities. Following our recent acquisition and the appointment of a new CEO, we are entering an exciting period of transformation, shifting toward a high\-growth, tech\-forward, and operationally excellent future. We are seeking a **Staff Engineer** to serve as the senior technical authority for our enterprise data architecture and engineering ecosystem. This highly influential individual contributor role that combines hands\-on development with strategic technical leadership, helping shape the future of our data platform while ensuring our Enterprise Data Warehouse remains scalable, reliable, secure, and aligned with business objectives. Reporting directly to the VP of Data, this role partners closely with Analytics, Business Intelligence, Technology, and business stakeholders to establish architectural standards, drive modernization initiatives, and enable data\-driven decision\-making across the organization. **What You'll Do** * Design, build, optimize, and troubleshoot production ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, SQL, and modern cloud data technologies. * Own the end\-to\-end architecture of the Enterprise Data Warehouse and Lakehouse environment across cloud\-based data platforms. * Establish and maintain data architecture standards including data modeling frameworks, metadata management, naming conventions, and governance practices. * Develop architecture diagrams, data flow documentation, and technical specifications that support engineering and business audiences alike. * Lead architecture reviews and guide cross\-functional teams through technical design decisions and trade\-off evaluations. * Partner with Business Intelligence, Analytics, Data Science, and business leaders to align platform capabilities with enterprise reporting and analytics needs. * Drive improvements in data quality, performance, scalability, reliability, and operational excellence across the data ecosystem. * Establish and promote best practices related to data governance, security, access controls, encryption, compliance, and lineage. * Mentor and influence data engineers by providing technical guidance, design reviews, and hands\-on coaching. * Troubleshoot complex production issues, identify root causes, and implement sustainable solutions. * Contribute to modernization efforts, including cloud migrations, platform enhancements, and the adoption of emerging data technologies. * Support the organization's strategic growth initiatives through scalable and trusted data solutions. **Who You Are** **The Technical Expert:** You possess deep expertise in modern data engineering and architecture and are equally comfortable designing enterprise\-scale solutions and personally writing production code. **The Architect:** You balance long\-term platform strategy with practical business needs, creating scalable solutions that support organizational growth. **The Trusted Advisor:** You influence technical decisions across teams and build consensus among stakeholders without relying on formal authority. **The Problem Solver:** You thrive on tackling complex technical challenges, quickly diagnosing issues and implementing thoughtful, sustainable solutions. **The Mentor:** You elevate the capabilities of those around you through coaching, technical leadership, and a commitment to engineering excellence. **Qualifications** **Experience** * 8\+ years of progressive experience in data engineering, including hands\-on development and enterprise data architecture ownership. * Proven experience designing, implementing, and supporting large\-scale Enterprise Data Warehouse and Lakehouse solutions. * Advanced experience developing production data pipelines using Python and SQL. * Experience with modern cloud\-based data platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS Redshift, or Databricks. * Experience working with ETL/ELT orchestration tools, including platforms such as Azure Data Factory, Airflow, dbt, Databricks Workflows, Glue, Informatica, or similar solutions. * Demonstrated success partnering with technical and business stakeholders to deliver scalable data architecture solutions. * Experience mentoring engineers and providing technical leadership within engineering organizations. * Financial services, consumer finance, or auto finance industry experience preferred. **Education** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field required. * Master's degree preferred. **Skills \& Abilities** * Deep expertise in enterprise data architecture, data warehousing, and cloud\-based data platforms. * Advanced proficiency with Python, SQL, and big data processing technologies such as Apache Spark and PySpark. * Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, Data Vault, Kimball, Inmon, and related data modeling methodologies. * Experience with CI/CD practices, source control tools, and infrastructure automation concepts. * Knowledge of data governance, security frameworks, compliance requirements, and data lineage practices. * Ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable recommendations for business and executive stakeholders. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting capabilities. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate effectively across teams and functions. * Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment while managing multiple priorities and competing demands. **Location \& Work Environment** **Location:** Remote opportunity or hybrid at our Glen Mills, PA, Tempe AZ, or Coppell, TX locations. **Schedule:** Full\-time position with standard business hours. **Why Join Us?** This is an opportunity to help shape the future of Flagship's enterprise data platform and become a key technical leader within a growing, data\-driven organization. You'll work alongside talented professionals, influence critical technology decisions, drive platform innovation, and help build the foundation that powers business insights across the enterprise. If you're passionate about modern data architecture, hands\-on engineering, and creating scalable solutions that make a measurable impact, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: VP of Global Sourcing, Power and Systems
jobs.description: Fluence (Nasdaq: FLNC) is a global market leader delivering intelligent energy storage and optimization software for renewables and storage. Our solutions and operational services are helping to create a more resilient grid and unlock the full potential of renewable portfolios. With gigawatts of successful implementations across nearly 50 markets, we are transforming the way we power our world for a more sustainable future. For more information, please visit fluenceenergy.com . **Job Description:** **Role Summary** The Vice President, Power and Systems leads Fluence's global direct materials strategy and execution across the power conversion, electrical systems, systems integration, and balance of plant portfolios. The role carries approximately $1\.2B in annual spend today. As Fluence converts contracted backlog and pipeline into deployed capacity, that portfolio is expected to exceed $5B in annual spend within three years. Scaling the function to carry that volume is the central mandate of this role. The supplier base, commercial structure, organization design, and cost discipline required at $5B differ materially from what supports the business today. This leader builds that capability while continuing to run the portfolio, without compromising cost performance, supply continuity, or quality through the ramp. Scale is not the objective on its own. Growing volume is leverage, and this role is accountable for converting it into significant year over year cost reduction and measurable gross margin improvement. Unit costs are expected to come down as volume goes up. Every incremental gigawatt is expected to strengthen Fluence's commercial position with its supply base. A leader who administers a larger portfolio at today's cost structure will not succeed here. This is a builder role rather than a caretaker role. It calls for a senior leader who is equally credible leading an enterprise cost review with the CFO and the CPO and reviewing a should cost teardown on a power conversion system at a supplier facility. Fluence is seeking an ambitious supply chain executive who wants a highly visible platform, accepts the demands of a multiyear scaling effort, and expects to be measured on results. The role reports directly to the Chief Procurement Officer and is a proving ground for the next level of executive leadership at Fluence. **Scope and Organization** This role consolidates the full non battery direct materials portfolio under a single leader, organized into two category towers led by Directors. * **Director, Power Conversion \& Electrical Systems.** Power conversion systems, inverters, transformers, UPS, and electrical and electronic controls. Also owns the Advanced Procurement function covering new product introduction, early supplier involvement, and design for cost. * **Director, Systems Integration \& Balance of Plant.** Enclosures, contract manufacturing, thermal management including HVAC, chillers and plumbing, fire detection and suppression, and system monitoring, software, and controls hardware. Also owns the Claims and Contracts function covering claims management, back charge recovery, contract administration, and dispute resolution. Beneath the two Directors sit Category Managers and Specialists across multiple regions. The Vice President owns the growth and design of that organization as spend scales. The Vice President sets portfolio strategy, cost targets, and supplier architecture, and leads the largest and most strategic negotiations. The Directors own category level execution, day to day supplier management, and delivery against committed targets. The Vice President is the escalation point on commercial disputes, capacity constraints, and cross tower tradeoffs. **Key Responsibilities** **1\. Organizational Design and Scale** * Design and build the direct materials organization required to carry the portfolio from its current level to more than $5B in annual spend. Own org design, job architecture, headcount planning, and the build, buy, or develop decision for each seat. * Establish the operating rhythm that makes scale possible: governance cadences, category strategy reviews, quarterly business reviews, cost reviews, and a single reporting standard across both towers. * Set category level KPIs and one source of truth on commercial contracts, quality, delivery, innovation, sustainability, and risk. Report a consolidated view to executive leadership. * Build process and systems capability that scales faster than headcount, so that growth in spend does not require proportional growth in team size. **2\. Category Strategy and Supplier Architecture** * Own and evolve the multiyear category strategy across the full portfolio, including commodity segmentation, make or buy decisions, and regional supply balance. * Architect a globally diversified and regionalized supplier base that is resilient to geopolitical exposure and single source risk, and that holds the physical capacity to support Fluence  ith CFO, CPO, and executive leadership. Board level reporting exposure preferred. * Working knowledge of regulatory, tax, and government manufacturing incentive compliance, traceability requirements, and domestic content rules relevant to energy storage supply chains. * Bachelor degree required in engineering, supply chain, or business. MBA or advanced technical degree preferred. **Leadership Profile** * A builder and an operator, equally credible presenting a business case to the executive team and standing on a supplier shop floor. Has progressed through doing and delivering rather than advising. * Ambitious and clear about it. Understands that scaling a portfolio of this size is how a leader earns the next seat, and wants that outcome. * Prepared for the demands of a multiyear scaling effort and motivated by the difficulty rather than deterred by it. * Treats scale as leverage. Sees every increase in volume as an opening to reset commercial terms, not as a reason to accept higher cost. * A systems level thinker with the discipline to go deep personally on the two or three issues that matter most in any given quarter. * A multiplier who builds team capability faster than the business adds headcount, rather than becoming the constraint. * Comfortable being measured on hard numbers, including COGS impact, PPV, OTIF, and supply continuity, rather than narrative or cost avoidance. * Executive presence that holds upward with the Board, the executive team, customers, and suppliers, and downward with Directors, Category Managers, and Engineers, without losing credibility in either direction. **Location and Travel** * Based in Houston, Texas, with an expectation of 3 to 4 days per week in the office. * Travel of 25 to 35 percent, domestic and international. **Our Culture** At Fluence, our culture is the foundation that drives our ambitious growth strategy and fuels our mission to transform the future of energy. Our core cultural pillars empower us to innovate, collaborate, and lead with purpose, ensuring we continue to deliver unparalleled value to our customers and the world. **Unleash Voices** We believe every voice matters. We encourage openness, active listening, and decisive action to create a culture where everyone has the opportunity to contribute to our success. We foster an environment where diverse perspectives are heard and valued, driving innovation and progress. **Customer Fluent** Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We’re committed to delivering exceptional value that exceeds expectations by understanding our customers' needs and adapting swiftly to meet them. Our deep focus on customer satisfaction drives us to continuously improve and innovate. **Infinite Impact** We are committed to creating the impossible. We push boundaries to deliver sustainable, game\-changing solutions that shape a brighter, more energy\-efficient future for all. Our team is passionate about making a lasting impact that will resonate for generations to come. **All In** We are all in for growth. Our teams are relentlessly focused on identifying and seizing opportunities that propel us forward. We embrace an ownership mindset, pushing ourselves and each other to accelerate progress and create lasting success. *Equal Opportunity Employer* *At Fluence, we believe great teams are built on a collaborative and connected culture. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and welcome qualified applicants of all backgrounds. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, gender identity or expression, genetic information, or any other status protected by law.* *Work Authorization* *To join our team, you’ll need to be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and throughout your employment, without the need for employer sponsorship. Please note that Fluence does not sponsor work visas for this position.*

jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer
jobs.description: ### **\\u007C About us:** Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition\-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs. Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer\-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money. Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost\-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low\-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet\-related diseases. At Foodsmart, our mission is to make nutritious food accessible and affordable for everyone, regardless of economic status. We are committed to a set of core values that shape our culture and work environment: Customer First \- You start with the member and work backwards. Make It Happen \- You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards. One Team \- You collaborate with respect and commit as a group. Whether you're a dietitian, a commercial leader, or a technologist, working at Foodsmart means being part of a team that is passionate, supportive, and driven by a shared purpose. Join us in transforming the way people access and enjoy healthy food. ### **\\u007C About the role:** Foodsmart is seeking a Staff AI Engineer who will play a critical leadership role in shaping the architecture and delivery of AI\-powered systems across the organization. You’ll operate at the intersection of backend engineering and applied machine learning—designing resilient infrastructure, deploying cutting\-edge models, and mentoring engineers across teams. This role goes beyond building software: it’s about setting strategy, elevating engineering standards, and turning AI innovation into scalable, real\-world impact. ### **You will** * Own the architecture and implementation of distributed, high\-scale backend systems and APIs that serve machine learning models in production. * Lead technical design for AI integration across product lines, enabling real\-time and batch inference workflows using LLMs, transformers, and classification models. * Drive the fine\-tuning and deployment of pre\-trained models (e.g., from Hugging Face or OpenAI) for mission\-critical business use cases in domains such as healthcare, finance, or operations. * Integrate external AI services where appropriate and evaluate trade\-offs for build vs. buy decisions. * Define and evolve platform\-wide standards for backend engineering, MLOps, model governance, and observability. * Mentor and support senior and mid\-level engineers, both within your team and across functions, to elevate system design and code quality. * Collaborate with cross\-functional leaders in product, ML research, data engineering, and DevOps to align technical initiatives with business goals. * Influence AI strategy and roadmap, evaluating emerging technologies and frameworks for future adoption. * Lead root\-cause analyses and performance tuning to ensure systems remain reliable, efficient, and scalable. ### **You are** * A senior technical leader with a demonstrated ability to architect, build, and scale AI\-backed systems in production environments. * Comfortable operating across layers—from backend API services to AI Services and ML model lifecycle management—while driving architectural clarity and system\-level thinking. * Experienced in bridging the gap between research and production, with a strong focus on reliability, maintainability, and business outcomes. * Skilled at leading cross\-team initiatives, guiding technical direction, and fostering a high\-trust engineering culture. * Able to influence without authority, collaborating across teams to align on complex technical trade\-offs. * Deeply invested in engineering excellence, with a strong bias toward automation, observability, and security. ### **You have** * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2\+ years at the Staff Engineer level or equivalent * 4\+ years of experience with backend development in TypeScript, Node.js, and SQL\-based RDBMS (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) * 1\+ years deploying ML/AI models to production, with hands\-on experience fine\-tuning LLMs or transformer\-based models * Deep understanding of system architecture, cloud infrastructure (AWS), and scalable API design * Strong experience with Data Pipeline tooling (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, dbt, Dagster) and model deployment practices * Proven leadership in setting technical direction, mentoring engineers, and driving cross\-team projects to completion * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field Role: Staff AI Engineer Location: United States (Remote) Base Salary Range: $190,000\-$210,000 Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Individual pay is determined by work location, job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. ### **\\u007C About our benefits and perks:** ✅ Remote\-First Company ✅ Unlimited PTO ✅ Flexible \& remote location ✅ Healthcare Coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision) ✅ 401k \& bonus ✅ Registered Dietitian Sessions Foodsmart is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It is our firm policy to extend equal employment and advancement opportunity to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship status, religious creed, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth and/or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, marital status, disability (physical or mental) and/or a medical condition, genetic information, ancestry, veteran status or service in the uniformed services, and any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Understand ORM tradeoffs and have basic NoSQL familiarity. * **Security:** Apply least\-privilege principles and understand timing attacks and encryption basics (PKI vs. symmetric). * **AI\-augmented development:** Use LLMs as part of the SDLC, including code review assistance, documentation drafting, and refactoring. Help the team rethink how work gets done with AI in the loop. * **Technical roadmap:** Identify areas of tech debt and propose focus areas for the team. * **Cross\-functional communication:** Present designs and tradeoffs to Product, DevSuccess, and Support. Translate technical constraints for non\-engineering partners. * **Technical influence:** Influence team decisions through clear reasoning. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **About the role** We are seeking a high\-impact, technically deep Machine Learning Engineer to develop, optimize, and deploy production ML models across our autonomous vehicle (AV) stack. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy building models end\-to\-end \- from data and training through optimization and real\-time deployment on autonomous vehicles. You will work closely with perception, prediction, planning, infrastructure, systems, and hardware teams to ensure models are efficient, scalable, reliable, and production\-ready for both on\-vehicle and cloud workflows. This role is onsite 5 days a week at our Santa Clara, CA office! **What you'll do** * **End\-to\-End Model Development:** Own the full ML lifecycle, including data strategy, preprocessing, training, evaluation, optimization, deployment, and monitoring. * **Autonomous Driving Models:** Develop and improve models supporting perception, prediction, planning, and scene understanding. * **Efficient Neural Network Design:** Optimize models using techniques such as quantization, pruning, sparsification, compression, and efficient architecture design to meet strict latency, compute, memory, and power constraints. * **Real\-Time Deployment:** Integrate trained models into C\+\+\-based autonomy systems and optimize inference for production vehicle hardware. * **Model Optimization:** Profile and optimize neural networks using CUDA, TensorRT, and related technologies. * **Simulation and Evaluation:** Analyze model performance using simulation and real\-world driving data, identify failure modes, and drive improvements. * **Scalable ML Infrastructure:** Build high\-throughput pipelines for training, evaluation, data processing, and large\-scale offline inference. * **Data Workflows and Tooling:** Develop reliable pipelines for dataset curation, annotation, preprocessing, visualization, diagnostics, benchmarking, and continuous feedback from field data. * **Cross\-Functional Integration:** Partner with autonomy, systems, hardware, and infrastructure teams to ensure ML components integrate reliably into the broader vehicle platform. **What we're looking for** * **Education:** MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Statistics, Optimization, or a related field. * **Experience:** Open to all experience levels. Leveling will be determined based on experience and technical depth. * **Programming \& Frameworks:** * Strong Python skills and experience with frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. * Strong C\+\+ skills and experience integrating ML models into high\-performance production systems. * **Core ML \& Systems Expertise:** * Deep understanding of ML workflows, including data curation, training, evaluation, ablation studies, deployment, and inference optimization. * Experience deploying and optimizing neural networks for real\-time, embedded, robotics, autonomous driving, or other performance\-constrained systems. * Experience with model optimization techniques such as quantization, pruning, compression, and efficient architectures. * Experience with software architecture, profiling, latency optimization, system\-level debugging, and data flow analysis. * **Infrastructure \& Compute Tools:** * Experience with CUDA and TensorRT is highly desirable. * Experience with cloud\-based ML training and evaluation pipelines, preferably Azure. **Bonus Qualifications:** * Experience with transformers, multimodal models, diffusion models, world models, or end\-to\-end driving models is a plus. * Experience in autonomous driving, robotics, or other safety\-critical real\-time ML systems is strongly preferred. * Publications or demonstrated technical contributions in efficient ML, autonomous driving, robotics, or related areas are a plus. * Prior contributions to large\-scale ML systems deployed in production. **Salary Range** $170,000 \- $240,000

jobs.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** **About the Team** The Compression and Parity team in GM's Autonomous Vehicle organization makes aggressive model optimization safe enough to ship repeatedly. We compress and quantize models headed for the car, and we own the analytical machinery that proves the compressed model still behaves like the original — not by assertion, but with bounded, quantified, auditable evidence. Every deployment decision our organization makes about a compressed model runs through the tooling this team builds. **About the Role** We are looking for a mathematically rigorous engineer to own model numerics: how we measure, bound, and reason about the numerical behavior of the models we ship — and how we turn that analysis into deployment decisions. The central question of this role is deceptively simple: given two numerically different versions of the same model, is the difference safe? Answering it well requires connecting things that are usually studied separately — floating\-point drift and Hessian conditioning on one end, vehicle trajectory error on the other. You will build the tooling that makes that connection quantitative, and you will define the thresholds that turn it into a ship / no\-ship decision. This role is not: running an existing validation harness and reporting the numbers it produces. When a parity check fails, the expectation is that you can say which operation caused the divergence and why — not merely that a difference exceeded a threshold. The tooling exists to make that investigation fast; it does not replace the investigation itself. **What You'll Do** * **Validate Optimized implementations** . Optimized implementations are supposed to be equivalent to their references. Establishing that rigorously, rather than by spot check, means deciding what equivalence should mean for a given operation, and designing the inputs that would expose a violation if one existed. * **Connect tensor differences to behavioral disparity.** Map low\-level numerical differences from quantization, compilation, and precision reduction to downstream driving behavior, using both open\-loop metrics (trajectory displacement error, perception IoU) and closed\-loop outcomes — and identify the mechanism behind the mapping, not just the correlation. * **Build sensitivity and robustness analysis tooling** . Use Jacobian/Hessian\-based methods to characterize how model outputs respond to weight and input perturbation, extend the same machinery to out\-of\-distribution inputs, and turn it into tooling that runs repeatedly across checkpoints — by engineers who are not you. * **Build training dynamics observability** . Design diagnostics that detect and root\-cause training instabilities — gradient vanishing and explosion, loss spikes, silent divergence — including decompositions of gradient and update trajectories into loss\-descent and oscillatory components under modern schedules such as WSD. * **Make it cheap enough to always be on** . Metric computation, gradient decomposition, and diagnostic logging have to run inside real distributed training jobs with negligible throughput cost and no OOM risk. Observability nobody can afford to enable is observability that doesn't exist. **Requirements:** We are deliberately strict on a small number of things and flexible on everything else. * **A working command of numerical analysis and matrix theory.** Jacobian/Hessian estimation, spectral properties, conditioning, and floating\-point error analysis should be tools you reach for by reflex, not topics you once studied. You should be able to say why an estimator's variance blows up, and when that matters. * **A real mental model of neural network training.** Loss landscapes, gradient and error propagation, optimizer dynamics, and the mechanics by which training goes wrong. You should have opinions about what a gradient norm spike does and does not tell you. * **An adversarial instinct for numerical edge cases.** Typical inputs rarely find anything. We are looking for someone who reaches for denormals, extreme dynamic range, catastrophic cancellation, degenerate shapes, and accumulation\-order effects — someone whose first question about a passing test is what that test failed to exercise. * **The engineering to make the math run** . High proficiency in PyTorch and Python, and a track record of building analytical tools that are both mathematically defensible and fast enough to be used in production training and evaluation loops. * **The judgment to make analysis actionable.** Much of this role is turning a numerical result into something an engineer who will not read your derivation can act on: knowing which quantity actually answers the question being asked, tracing an anomalous number back to the operation that produced it, etc * Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Applied Mathematics, Control, Physics, Computer Science, Data Science, or a closely related quantitative field. **What You'll Learn Here** You are not expected to arr ing low\-overhead observability over sharded parameter and gradient state. * **Experience in quantization, compiler toolchains, or inference\-time numerical parity.** * Experience building or scaling evaluation pipelines and its metrics formulation for AV or ADAS systems. * **Published or applied work in model robustness, OOD generalization, or adversarial/perturbation analysis.** **Compensation:** The compensation information is a good faith estimate only. jobs.title: Software Engineer III, Copilot Models Inference
jobs.description: About GitHub: GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot. Locations: In this role you can work from Remote, United States Overview: As a software engineer at GitHub, you will enhance the collaboration experience at GitHub by working closely with a community of engineers and designers with a distributed, diverse and passionate team delivering the services that millions of developers depend on. In this role you will design, prototype, implement, ship and support highly performant and inspiring user experiences with your team. The GitHub Copilot Models Inference team builds and operates the backend services and APIs that connect Copilot experiences to AI model providers. These systems make models available safely and reliably at global scale while managing the production realities of provider integrations, request routing, service health, latency, capacity, and changing model availability. As a Software Engineer III, you will deliver production features end to end and help operate the services you change. You will participate in design and code reviews, build tests and operational safeguards, prepare changes for rollout, and use production signals to improve reliability and performance. Clear communication matters on this distributed team. You will work with engineers and partners across Models Lifecycle, product, safety, infrastructure, and external model providers through a mix of live conversations and thoughtful written updates. jobs.title: Research Engineer (ML)
jobs.description: **Category:** ------------- Science **Lab/Area:** ------------- Finkbeiner Lab **Description:** ---------------- **Who we are:** The Gladstone Institutes is a leading independent, not\-for\-profit research organization dedicated to improving human health through groundbreaking biomedical research and education. Our work spans neuroscience, cardiovascular biology, immunology, and stem cell biology, with a strong emphasis on understanding and treating disease. With approximately 600 team members, including world\-renowned scientists and biomedical leaders, Gladstone fosters a collaborative and innovative environment. Located in Mission Bay in a state\-of\-the\-art facility, we offer competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and the resources to empower individuals to maximize their potential and make a meaningful impact on global health. **About the Role:** The Finkbeiner Lab at Gladstone Institutes is seeking a ML Research Engineer to join a team of computer scientists applying AI/ML in diverse biomedical research projects. This involves working closely with biologists, imaging scientists, and engineers to accelerate the lab's computational efforts, developing, adapting, and translating cutting\-edge machine learning methods into tools that meaningfully speed up discovery in neurodegeneration and other disease areas. This is a highly collaborative position for someone who wants their ML work to directly shape how biological experiments are designed and run, advance neurodegenerative disease research by uncovering meaningful correlations across pathology datasets, and help lab members improve and scale cell image analysis pipelines. The role will also contribute to advancing our “thinking microscope” — an intelligent live\-cell imaging platform that uses closed\-loop machine learning to autonomously guide experiments and accelerate scientific discovery. **What you will do:** * Deploy Computer Vision and RL Pipelines : Design, implement, and deploy computer vision approaches and reinforcement learning pipelines for high\-content cellular imaging data, including adaptive acquisition strategies for automated microscopy. * Train \& Fine\-Tune Models : Train, fine\-tune, and benchmark multimodal models for pathology, cell segmentation across large longitudinal imaging, sequencing datasets, and evaluate performance against biologically meaningful metrics. * Accelerate Computational Research : Partner with lab members to streamline AI/ML workflows, improve data processing efficiency, and resolve complex computational bottlenecks in ongoing experiments. * Drive Collaborative \& Grant Initiatives : Partner with internal and external collaborators, contribute to manuscripts and presentations, and help lead grant writing efforts by developing the computational aims, preliminary data, and methods narratives that drive successful proposals. * Demystify AI for Biology: Translate complex computational concepts into clear, actionable insights for non\-technical team members and interdisciplinary collaborators. **What you will need:** * Education \& Experience : Requires Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, physics or related field. 4\+ years of related experience for individuals with a BS/BA or 2\+ years of related experience for individuals with a MS degree * Frameworks, Infrastructure \& Scaling: Hands\-on experience with deep learning tools (PyTorch, JAX, OpenCV, Hugging Face), MLOps frameworks (Docker, containerization, Computer Systems) and distributed platforms (Slurm, Kubernetes) and software engineering practices * Domain Expertise: Practical experience applying machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, transformer architectures, and reinforcement learning. * Interdisciplinary Drive and Leadership Skills : Genuine curiosity for biological discovery and a strong motivation to apply AI to solve complex biological problems, and a willingness and capacity to seek out new emerging solutions from across computer science. * Communication \& Teamwork : Proven ability to explain technical ML concepts to non\-technical stakeholders, with a collaborative, team\-first mindset. **What is preferred:** * Prior experience with biological or biomedical image analysis, including microscopy data, cell segmentation, or object tracking * Experience applying reinforcement learning to real\-world control problems, particularly closed\-loop or instrument\-in\-the\-loop systems * Hands\-on experience with distributed training, fine\-tuning, or deploying large\-scale vision or multimodal foundational models **Salary Range:** $88K \- $120K **Gladstone Perks \& Benefits** * *People* –work with talented, committed, and supportive teammates within an organization that values each member of its community. * *A meaningful place to grow and learn* –whether it’s your professional skills or scientific knowledge, we have the resources and environment to advance either so you can better support Gladstone’s mission to drive a new era of discovery in disease\-oriented science and to mentor tomorrow’s leaders in an inspiring and excellent environment. * *Healthy work/life balance* –you are highly engaged and productive at work because you can have time to recharge and enjoy a vibrant life outside of work. * *Compensation* –competitive salary. Title and salary will be commensurate with education and experience. * *Excellent benefits* –generous medical, dental, vision, retirement plan, paid vacation, commuter benefits, access to free shuttle transportation. Gladstone is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, sex, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, medical condition, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other non\-job related characteristic. We make all employment decisions so as to further this principle of equal employment.

face to C level executives * Knowledge of best of breed softwares and a technical understanding of integrations, APIs, infrastructure management, security and analytics * Experience selling technical jobs.description: This role is not eligible for U.S. immigration sponsorship. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New Albany, OH, USA; Lancaster, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Experience with performing component\-level repairs and troubleshooting on technical equipment. * Experience diagnosing and troubleshooting one of the following: operating systems, computer/server hardware, or networking protocols. * Ability to lift/move 50lb (23kg) of equipment and ability to exert yourself physically over extended periods of time, including frequent bending, kneeling, climbing, pushing/pulling and lifting. * Must have the ability to work non\-standard hours, including working weekends, night shifts, holidays and on shift\-based schedules as required. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * Completion of the online Google IT Support Professional Certificate program. * 2 years of experience diagnosing and troubleshooting one of the following: operating systems and computer/server hardware or networking protocols. * Experience with performing component\-level repairs and troubleshooting on IT equipment or in a similar role (e.g. Systems Administration, Network Deployment Engineer, Help Desk Technician, etc). * Experience working within a data center or network operation center environment. * Ability to collaborate and partner with teams to overcome challenges, and to adapt to changes in a dynamic work environment. **About the job** ----------------- Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state\-of\-the\-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting\-edge of computer technology. The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. Additionally SRE’s will keep an ever\-watchful eye on our systems capacity and performance. Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation.
